10257.label: 1 Chronicles 1:5
10257.text: The sons of Jaʹpheth were Goʹmer and Maʹgog and Maʹda·i and Jaʹvan and Tuʹbal and Meʹshech and Tiʹras.

10258.label: 1 Chronicles 1:6
10258.text: And the sons of Goʹmer were Ashʹke·naz and Riʹphath and To·garʹmah.

10259.label: 1 Chronicles 1:7
10259.text: And the sons of Jaʹvan were E·liʹshah and Tarʹshish, Kitʹtim and Roʹda·nim.

10260.label: 1 Chronicles 1:8
10260.text: The sons of Ham were Cush and Mizʹra·im, Put and Caʹnaan.

10261.label: 1 Chronicles 1:9
10261.text: And the sons of Cush were Seʹba and Havʹi·lah and Sabʹtah and Raʹa·mah and Sabʹte·ca. And the sons of Raʹa·mah were Sheʹba and Deʹdan.

10262.label: 1 Chronicles 1:10
10262.text: And Cush himself became father to Nimʹrod. He it was that made the start in becoming a mighty one in the earth.

10263.label: 1 Chronicles 1:11
10263.text: As for Mizʹra·im, he became father to Luʹdim and Anʹa·mim and Le·haʹbim and Naph·tuʹhim

10264.label: 1 Chronicles 1:12
10264.text: and Path·ruʹsim and Cas·luʹhim (from among whom the Phi·lisʹtines went forth) and Caphʹto·rim.

10265.label: 1 Chronicles 1:13
10265.text: As for Caʹnaan, he became father to Siʹdon his firstborn and Heth

10266.label: 1 Chronicles 1:14
10266.text: and the Jebʹu·site and the Amʹor·ite and the Girʹga·shite

10267.label: 1 Chronicles 1:15
10267.text: and the Hiʹvite and the Arkʹite and the Siʹnite

10268.label: 1 Chronicles 1:16
10268.text: and the Arʹvad·ite and the Zemʹa·rite and the Haʹmath·ite.

10269.label: 1 Chronicles 1:17
10269.text: The sons of Shem were Eʹlam and Asʹshur and Ar·pachʹshad and Lud and Aʹram, And Uz and Hul and Geʹther and Mash.

10270.label: 1 Chronicles 1:18
10270.text: As for Ar·pachʹshad, he became father to Sheʹlah, and Sheʹlah himself became father to Eʹber.

10271.label: 1 Chronicles 1:19
10271.text: And to Eʹber two sons were born. The name of the one was Peʹleg, because in his days the earth was divided; and the name of his brother was Jokʹtan.

10272.label: 1 Chronicles 1:20
10272.text: As for Jokʹtan, he became father to Al·moʹdad and Sheʹleph and Ha·zar·maʹveth and Jeʹrah

10273.label: 1 Chronicles 1:21
10273.text: and Ha·doʹram and Uʹzal and Dikʹlah

10274.label: 1 Chronicles 1:22
10274.text: and Oʹbal and A·bimʹa·el and Sheʹba

10275.label: 1 Chronicles 1:23
10275.text: and Oʹphir and Havʹi·lah and Joʹbab; all these were the sons of Jokʹtan.

10279.label: 1 Chronicles 1:27
10279.text: Aʹbram, that is to say, Abraham.

10280.label: 1 Chronicles 1:28
10280.text: The sons of Abraham were Isaac and Ishʹma·el.

10281.label: 1 Chronicles 1:29
10281.text: These are their family origins: Ishʹma·el’s firstborn Ne·baʹioth and Keʹdar and Adʹbe·el and Mibʹsam,

10282.label: 1 Chronicles 1:30
10282.text: Mishʹma and Duʹmah, Masʹsa, Haʹdad and Teʹma,

10283.label: 1 Chronicles 1:31
10283.text: Jeʹtur, Naʹphish and Kedʹe·mah. These were the sons of Ishʹma·el.

10284.label: 1 Chronicles 1:32
10284.text: As for the sons of Ke·tuʹrah, Abraham’s concubine, she gave birth to Zimʹran and Jokʹshan and Meʹdan and Midʹi·an and Ishʹbak and Shuʹah. And the sons of Jokʹshan were Sheʹba and Deʹdan.

10285.label: 1 Chronicles 1:33
10285.text: And the sons of Midʹi·an were Eʹphah and Eʹpher and Haʹnoch and A·biʹda and El·daʹah. All these were the sons of Ke·tuʹrah.

10286.label: 1 Chronicles 1:34
10286.text: And Abraham came to be father to Isaac. The sons of Isaac were Eʹsau and Israel.

10287.label: 1 Chronicles 1:35
10287.text: The sons of Eʹsau were Elʹi·phaz, Reuʹel and Jeʹush and Jaʹlam and Koʹrah.

10288.label: 1 Chronicles 1:36
10288.text: The sons of Elʹi·phaz were Teʹman and Oʹmar, Zeʹpho and Gaʹtam, Keʹnaz and Timʹna and Amʹa·lek.

10289.label: 1 Chronicles 1:37
10289.text: The sons of Reuʹel were Naʹhath, Zeʹrah, Shamʹmah and Mizʹzah.

10290.label: 1 Chronicles 1:38
10290.text: And the sons of Seʹir were Loʹtan and Shoʹbal and Zibʹe·on and Aʹnah and Diʹshon and Eʹzer and Diʹshan.

10291.label: 1 Chronicles 1:39
10291.text: And the sons of Loʹtan were Hoʹri and Hoʹmam. And Loʹtan’s sister was Timʹna.

10292.label: 1 Chronicles 1:40
10292.text: The sons of Shoʹbal were Alʹvan and Manʹa·hath and Eʹbal, Sheʹpho and Oʹnam. And the sons of Zibʹe·on were Aʹiah and Aʹnah.

10293.label: 1 Chronicles 1:41
10293.text: The sons of Aʹnah were Diʹshon. And the sons of Diʹshon were Hemʹdan and Eshʹban and Ithʹran and Cheʹran.

10294.label: 1 Chronicles 1:42
10294.text: The sons of Eʹzer were Bilʹhan and Zaʹa·van and Aʹkan. The sons of Diʹshan were Uz and Aʹran.

10295.label: 1 Chronicles 1:43
10295.text: And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Eʹdom before any king reigned over the sons of Israel: Beʹla the son of Beʹor, the name of whose city was Dinʹha·bah.

10296.label: 1 Chronicles 1:44
10296.text: Eventually Beʹla died, and Joʹbab the son of Zeʹrah from Bozʹrah began to reign in place of him.

10297.label: 1 Chronicles 1:45
10297.text: Eventually Joʹbab died, and Huʹsham from the land of the Teʹman·ites began to reign in place of him.

10298.label: 1 Chronicles 1:46
10298.text: Eventually Huʹsham died, and Haʹdad the son of Beʹdad, who defeated Midʹi·an in the field of Moʹab, began to reign in place of him. And the name of his city was Aʹvith.

10299.label: 1 Chronicles 1:47
10299.text: Eventually Haʹdad died, and Samʹlah from Mas·reʹkah began to reign in place of him.

10300.label: 1 Chronicles 1:48
10300.text: Eventually Samʹlah died, and Shaʹul from Re·hoʹboth by the River began to reign in place of him.

10301.label: 1 Chronicles 1:49
10301.text: Eventually Shaʹul died, and Baʹal-haʹnan the son of Achʹbor began to reign in place of him.

10302.label: 1 Chronicles 1:50
10302.text: Eventually Baʹal-haʹnan died, and Haʹdad began to reign in place of him; and the name of his city was Paʹu, and the name of his wife was Me·hetʹa·bel, the daughter of Maʹtred, the daughter of Meʹza·hab.

10303.label: 1 Chronicles 1:51
10303.text: Eventually Haʹdad died. And the sheiks of Eʹdom came to be sheik Timʹna, sheik Alʹvah, sheik Jeʹtheth,

10304.label: 1 Chronicles 1:52
10304.text: sheik O·hol·i·baʹmah, sheik Eʹlah, sheik Piʹnon,

10305.label: 1 Chronicles 1:53
10305.text: sheik Keʹnaz, sheik Teʹman, sheik Mibʹzar,

10306.label: 1 Chronicles 1:54
10306.text: sheik Magʹdi·el, sheik Iʹram. These were the sheiks of Eʹdom.

10307.label: 1 Chronicles 2:1
10307.text: These were the sons of Israel: Reuʹben, Simʹe·on, Leʹvi and Judah, Isʹsa·char and Zebʹu·lun,

10308.label: 1 Chronicles 2:2
10308.text: Dan, Joseph and Benjamin, Naphʹta·li, Gad and Ashʹer.

10309.label: 1 Chronicles 2:3
10309.text: The sons of Judah were Er and Oʹnan and Sheʹlah. The three were born to him from Shuʹa’s daughter, the Caʹnaan·it·ess. And Er the firstborn of Judah came to be bad in the eyes of Jehovah, so that he put him to death.

10310.label: 1 Chronicles 2:4
10310.text: And Taʹmar his daughter-in-law it was that bore to him Peʹrez and Zeʹrah. All the sons of Judah were five.

10311.label: 1 Chronicles 2:5
10311.text: The sons of Peʹrez were Hezʹron and Haʹmul.

10312.label: 1 Chronicles 2:6
10312.text: And the sons of Zeʹrah were Zimʹri and Eʹthan and Heʹman and Calʹcol and Daʹra. There were five of them in all.

10313.label: 1 Chronicles 2:7
10313.text: And the sons of Carʹmi were Aʹchar the bringer of ostracism upon Israel, who committed an act of unfaithfulness respecting the thing devoted to destruction.

10314.label: 1 Chronicles 2:8
10314.text: And the sons of Eʹthan were Az·a·riʹah.

10315.label: 1 Chronicles 2:9
10315.text: And the sons of Hezʹron that were born to him were Je·rahʹme·el and Ram and Che·luʹbai.

10316.label: 1 Chronicles 2:10
10316.text: As for Ram, he became father to Am·minʹa·dab. Am·minʹa·dab, in turn, became father to Nahʹshon the chieftain of the sons of Judah.

10317.label: 1 Chronicles 2:11
10317.text: Nahʹshon, in turn, became father to Salʹma. Salʹma, in turn, became father to Boʹaz.

10318.label: 1 Chronicles 2:12
10318.text: Boʹaz, in turn, became father to Oʹbed. Oʹbed, in turn, became father to Jesʹse.

10319.label: 1 Chronicles 2:13
10319.text: Jesʹse, in turn, became father to his firstborn E·liʹab, and A·binʹa·dab the second, and Shimʹe·a the third,

10320.label: 1 Chronicles 2:14
10320.text: Ne·thanʹel the fourth, Radʹdai the fifth,

10321.label: 1 Chronicles 2:15
10321.text: Oʹzem the sixth, David the seventh.

10322.label: 1 Chronicles 2:16
10322.text: And their sisters were Ze·ruʹiah and Abʹi·gail; and the sons of Ze·ruʹiah were A·bishʹai and Joʹab and Asʹa·hel, three.

10323.label: 1 Chronicles 2:17
10323.text: As for Abʹi·gail, she gave birth to A·maʹsa; and the father of A·maʹsa was Jeʹther the Ishʹma·el·ite.

10324.label: 1 Chronicles 2:18
10324.text: As for Caʹleb the son of Hezʹron, he became father to sons by A·zuʹbah his wife and by Jerʹi·oth; and these were her sons: Jeʹsher and Shoʹbab and Arʹdon.

10325.label: 1 Chronicles 2:19
10325.text: Eventually A·zuʹbah died. So Caʹleb took to himself Ephʹrath, who in time bore Hur to him.

10326.label: 1 Chronicles 2:20
10326.text: Hur, in turn, became father to Uʹri. Uʹri, in turn, became father to Bezʹal·el.

10327.label: 1 Chronicles 2:21
10327.text: And afterward Hezʹron had relations with the daughter of Maʹchir the father of Gilʹe·ad. And he himself took her when he was sixty years old, but she bore Seʹgub to him.

10328.label: 1 Chronicles 2:22
10328.text: Seʹgub, in turn, became father to Jaʹir, who came to have twenty-three cities in the land of Gilʹe·ad.

10329.label: 1 Chronicles 2:23
10329.text: Later Geshʹur and Syria took Havʹvoth-jaʹir from them, with Keʹnath and its dependent towns, sixty cities. All these were the sons of Maʹchir the father of Gilʹe·ad.

10330.label: 1 Chronicles 2:24
10330.text: And after the death of Hezʹron in Caʹleb-ephʹra·thah, with A·biʹjah being the wife of Hezʹron, she then bore him Ashʹhur the father of Te·koʹa.

10331.label: 1 Chronicles 2:25
10331.text: And the sons of Je·rahʹme·el the firstborn of Hezʹron were Ram the firstborn and Buʹnah and Oʹren and Oʹzem, A·hiʹjah.

10332.label: 1 Chronicles 2:26
10332.text: And Je·rahʹme·el came to have another wife, whose name was Atʹa·rah. She was the mother of Oʹnam.

10333.label: 1 Chronicles 2:27
10333.text: And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Je·rahʹme·el came to be Maʹaz and Jaʹmin and Eʹker.

10334.label: 1 Chronicles 2:28
10334.text: And the sons of Oʹnam came to be Shamʹmai and Jaʹda. And the sons of Shamʹmai were Naʹdab and A·biʹshur.

10335.label: 1 Chronicles 2:29
10335.text: And the name of A·biʹshur’s wife was Abʹi·ha·il, who in time bore him Ahʹban and Moʹlid.

10336.label: 1 Chronicles 2:30
10336.text: And the sons of Naʹdab were Seʹled and Apʹpa·im. But Seʹled died without sons.

10337.label: 1 Chronicles 2:31
10337.text: And the sons of Apʹpa·im were Ishʹi. And the sons of Ishʹi were Sheʹshan; and the sons of Sheʹshan, Ahʹlai.

10338.label: 1 Chronicles 2:32
10338.text: And the sons of Jaʹda the brother of Shamʹmai were Jeʹther and Jonʹa·than. But Jeʹther died without sons.

10339.label: 1 Chronicles 2:33
10339.text: And the sons of Jonʹa·than were Peʹleth and Zaʹza. These became the sons of Je·rahʹme·el.

10340.label: 1 Chronicles 2:34
10340.text: And Sheʹshan came to have no sons, but daughters. Now Sheʹshan had an Egyptian servant whose name was Jarʹha.

10341.label: 1 Chronicles 2:35
10341.text: So Sheʹshan gave his daughter to Jarʹha his servant as a wife, who in time bore him Atʹtai.

10342.label: 1 Chronicles 2:36
10342.text: Atʹtai, in turn, became father to Nathan. Nathan, in turn, became father to Zaʹbad.

10343.label: 1 Chronicles 2:37
10343.text: Zaʹbad, in turn, became father to Ephʹlal. Ephʹlal, in turn, became father to Oʹbed.

10344.label: 1 Chronicles 2:38
10344.text: Oʹbed, in turn, became father to Jeʹhu. Jeʹhu, in turn, became father to Az·a·riʹah.

10345.label: 1 Chronicles 2:39
10345.text: Az·a·riʹah, in turn, became father to Heʹlez. Heʹlez, in turn, became father to El·e·aʹsah.

10346.label: 1 Chronicles 2:40
10346.text: El·e·aʹsah, in turn, became father to Sisʹmai. Sisʹmai, in turn, became father to Shalʹlum.

10347.label: 1 Chronicles 2:41
10347.text: Shalʹlum, in turn, became father to Jek·a·miʹah. Jek·a·miʹah, in turn, became father to E·lishʹa·ma.

10348.label: 1 Chronicles 2:42
10348.text: And the sons of Caʹleb the brother of Je·rahʹme·el were Meʹsha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and the sons of Ma·reʹshah the father of Heʹbron.

10349.label: 1 Chronicles 2:43
10349.text: And the sons of Heʹbron were Koʹrah and Tapʹpu·ah and Reʹkem and Sheʹma.

10350.label: 1 Chronicles 2:44
10350.text: Sheʹma, in turn, became father to Raʹham the father of Jorʹke·am. Reʹkem, in turn, became father to Shamʹmai.

10351.label: 1 Chronicles 2:45
10351.text: And the son of Shamʹmai was Maʹon; and Maʹon was the father of Beth-zur.

10352.label: 1 Chronicles 2:46
10352.text: As for Eʹphah the concubine of Caʹleb, she gave birth to Haʹran and Moʹza and Gaʹzez. As for Haʹran, he became father to Gaʹzez.

10353.label: 1 Chronicles 2:47
10353.text: And the sons of Jahʹdai were Reʹgem and Joʹtham and Geʹshan and Pelʹet and Eʹphah and Shaʹaph.

10354.label: 1 Chronicles 2:48
10354.text: As for Caʹleb’s concubine Maʹa·cah, she gave birth to Sheʹber and Tirʹha·nah.

10355.label: 1 Chronicles 2:49
10355.text: In time she bore Shaʹaph the father of Mad·manʹnah, Sheʹva the father of Mach·beʹnah and the father of Gibʹe·a. And Caʹleb’s daughter was Achʹsah.

10356.label: 1 Chronicles 2:50
10356.text: These became the sons of Caʹleb. The sons of Hur the firstborn of Ephʹra·thah: Shoʹbal the father of Kirʹi·ath-jeʹa·rim,

10357.label: 1 Chronicles 2:51
10357.text: Salʹma the father of Bethʹle·hem, Haʹreph the father of Beth-gaʹder.

10358.label: 1 Chronicles 2:52
10358.text: And Shoʹbal the father of Kirʹi·ath-jeʹa·rim came to have sons: Ha·roʹeh, half of the Me·nuʹhoth.

10359.label: 1 Chronicles 2:53
10359.text: And the families of Kirʹi·ath-jeʹa·rim were the Ithʹrites and the Puʹthites and the Shuʹmath·ites and the Mishʹra·ites. It was from these that the Zoʹrath·ites and the Eshʹta·ol·ites came out.

10360.label: 1 Chronicles 2:54
10360.text: The sons of Salʹma were Bethʹle·hem and the Ne·tophʹa·thites, Atʹroth-beth-joʹab and half of the Man·a·haʹthites, the Zorʹites.

10361.label: 1 Chronicles 2:55
10361.text: And the families of the scribes dwelling at Jaʹbez were the Tiʹrath·ites, the Shimʹe·ath·ites, the Suʹcath·ites. These were the Kenʹites that came from Hamʹmath the father of the house of Reʹchab.

10362.label: 1 Chronicles 3:1
10362.text: And these became the sons of David that were born to him in Heʹbron: the firstborn Amʹnon, of A·hinʹo·am the Jezʹre·el·i·tess, the second, Daniel, of Abʹi·gail the Carʹmel·it·ess,

10363.label: 1 Chronicles 3:2
10363.text: the third, Abʹsa·lom the son of Maʹa·cah the daughter of Talʹmai the king of Geshʹur, the fourth, Ad·o·niʹjah the son of Hagʹgith,

10364.label: 1 Chronicles 3:3
10364.text: the fifth, Sheph·a·tiʹah, of A·biʹtal, the sixth, Ithʹre·am, of Egʹlah his wife.

10365.label: 1 Chronicles 3:4
10365.text: There were six born to him in Heʹbron; and he continued to reign there seven years and six months, and for thirty-three years he reigned in Jerusalem.

10366.label: 1 Chronicles 3:5
10366.text: And there were these born to him in Jerusalem: Shimʹe·a and Shoʹbab and Nathan and Solʹo·mon, four of Bath-sheʹba the daughter of Amʹmi·el,

10367.label: 1 Chronicles 3:6
10367.text: and Ibʹhar and E·lishʹa·ma and E·liphʹe·let,

10368.label: 1 Chronicles 3:7
10368.text: and Noʹgah and Neʹpheg and Ja·phiʹa,

10369.label: 1 Chronicles 3:8
10369.text: and E·lishʹa·ma and E·liʹa·da and E·liphʹe·let, nine,

10370.label: 1 Chronicles 3:9
10370.text: all the sons of David besides the sons of the concubines, and Taʹmar their sister.

10371.label: 1 Chronicles 3:10
10371.text: And the son of Solʹo·mon was Re·ho·boʹam, A·biʹjah his son, Aʹsa his son, Je·hoshʹa·phat his son,

10372.label: 1 Chronicles 3:11
10372.text: Je·hoʹram his son, A·ha·ziʹah his son, Je·hoʹash his son,

10373.label: 1 Chronicles 3:12
10373.text: Am·a·ziʹah his son, Az·a·riʹah his son, Joʹtham his son,

10374.label: 1 Chronicles 3:13
10374.text: Aʹhaz his son, Hez·e·kiʹah his son, Ma·nasʹseh his son,

10375.label: 1 Chronicles 3:14
10375.text: Aʹmon his son, Jo·siʹah his son.

10376.label: 1 Chronicles 3:15
10376.text: And the sons of Jo·siʹah were the firstborn Jo·haʹnan, the second, Je·hoiʹa·kim, the third, Zed·e·kiʹah, the fourth, Shalʹlum.

10377.label: 1 Chronicles 3:16
10377.text: And the sons of Je·hoiʹa·kim were Jec·o·niʹah his son, Zed·e·kiʹah his son.

10378.label: 1 Chronicles 3:17
10378.text: And the sons of Jec·o·niʹah as prisoner were She·alʹti·el his son

10379.label: 1 Chronicles 3:18
10379.text: and Mal·chiʹram and Pe·daiʹah and She·nazʹzar, Jek·a·miʹah, Hoshʹa·ma and Ned·a·biʹah.

10380.label: 1 Chronicles 3:19
10380.text: And the sons of Pe·daiʹah were Ze·rubʹba·bel and Shimʹe·i; and the sons of Ze·rubʹba·bel were Me·shulʹlam and Han·a·niʹah (and She·loʹmith was their sister);

10381.label: 1 Chronicles 3:20
10381.text: and Ha·shuʹbah and Oʹhel and Ber·e·chiʹah and Has·a·diʹah, Juʹshab-heʹsed, five.

10382.label: 1 Chronicles 3:21
10382.text: And the sons of Han·a·niʹah were Pel·a·tiʹah and Je·shaʹiah, the sons of [Je·shaʹiah] Re·phaʹiah, the sons of [Re·phaʹiah] Arʹnan, the sons of [Arʹnan] O·ba·diʹah, the sons of [O·ba·diʹah] Shec·a·niʹah;

10383.label: 1 Chronicles 3:22
10383.text: and the sons of Shec·a·niʹah, She·maiʹah, and the sons of She·maiʹah, Hatʹtush and Iʹgal and Ba·riʹah and Ne·a·riʹah and Shaʹphat, six.

10384.label: 1 Chronicles 3:23
10384.text: And the sons of Ne·a·riʹah were Eli·o·eʹnai and Hiz·kiʹah and Az·riʹkam, three.

10385.label: 1 Chronicles 3:24
10385.text: And the sons of Eli·o·eʹnai were Hod·a·viʹah and E·liʹa·shib and Pe·laʹiah and Akʹkub and Jo·haʹnan and De·laʹiah and A·naʹni, seven.

10386.label: 1 Chronicles 4:1
10386.text: The sons of Judah were Peʹrez, Hezʹron and Carʹmi and Hur and Shoʹbal.

10387.label: 1 Chronicles 4:2
10387.text: As for Re·aʹiah the son of Shoʹbal, he became father to Jaʹhath; Jaʹhath, in turn, became father to A·huʹmai and Laʹhad. These were the families of the Zoʹrath·ites.

10388.label: 1 Chronicles 4:3
10388.text: And these were [the sons of] the father of Eʹtam: Jezʹre·el and Ishʹma and Idʹbash, (and the name of their sister was Haz·ze·lel·poʹni,)

10389.label: 1 Chronicles 4:4
10389.text: and Pe·nuʹel the father of Geʹdor and Eʹzer the father of Huʹshah. These were the sons of Hur the firstborn of Ephʹra·thah the father of Bethʹle·hem.

10390.label: 1 Chronicles 4:5
10390.text: And Ashʹhur the father of Te·koʹa came to have two wives, Heʹlah and Naʹa·rah.

10391.label: 1 Chronicles 4:6
10391.text: In time Naʹa·rah bore to him A·huzʹzam and Heʹpher and Teʹme·ni and Ha·a·hashʹta·ri. These were the sons of Naʹa·rah.

10392.label: 1 Chronicles 4:7
10392.text: And the sons of Heʹlah were Zeʹreth, Izʹhar and Ethʹnan.

10393.label: 1 Chronicles 4:8
10393.text: As for Koz, he became father to Aʹnub and Zo·beʹbah and the families of A·harʹhel the son of Haʹrum.

10394.label: 1 Chronicles 4:9
10394.text: And Jaʹbez came to be more honorable than his brothers; and it was his mother that called his name Jaʹbez, saying: “I have given him birth in pain.”

10395.label: 1 Chronicles 4:10
10395.text: And Jaʹbez began to call upon the God of Israel, saying: “If you will without fail bless me and actually enlarge my territory and your hand really proves to be with me, and you really preserve [me] from calamity, that it may not hurt me, —” Accordingly God brought [to pass] what he had asked.

10396.label: 1 Chronicles 4:11
10396.text: As for Cheʹlub the brother of Shuʹhah, he became father to Meʹhir, who was the father of Eshʹton.

10397.label: 1 Chronicles 4:12
10397.text: Eshʹton, in turn, became father to Beth-raʹpha and Pa·seʹah and Te·hinʹnah the father of Ir-naʹhash. These were the men of Reʹcah.

10398.label: 1 Chronicles 4:13
10398.text: And the sons of Keʹnaz were Othʹni·el and Se·raiʹah, and the sons of Othʹni·el, Haʹthath.

10399.label: 1 Chronicles 4:14
10399.text: As for Me·oʹno·thai, he became father to Ophʹrah. As for Se·raiʹah, he became father to Joʹab the father of Ge-harʹa·shim; for craftsmen are what they became.

10400.label: 1 Chronicles 4:15
10400.text: And the sons of Caʹleb the son of Je·phunʹneh were Iʹru, Eʹlah and Naʹam; and the sons of Eʹlah, Keʹnaz.

10401.label: 1 Chronicles 4:16
10401.text: And the sons of Je·halʹle·lel were Ziph and Ziʹphah, Tirʹi·a and Asʹa·rel.

10402.label: 1 Chronicles 4:17
10402.text: And the sons of Ezʹrah were Jeʹther and Meʹred and Eʹpher and Jaʹlon; and she got to conceive Mirʹi·am and Shamʹmai and Ishʹbah the father of Esh·te·moʹa.

10403.label: 1 Chronicles 4:18
10403.text: As for his Jewish wife, she gave birth to Jeʹred the father of Geʹdor and Heʹber the father of Soʹco and Je·kuʹthi·el the father of Za·noʹah. And these were the sons of Bi·thiʹah the daughter of Pharʹaoh, whom Meʹred took.

10404.label: 1 Chronicles 4:19
10404.text: And the sons of Ho·diʹah’s wife, the sister of Naʹham, were the father of Keiʹlah the Garʹmite and Esh·te·moʹa the Ma·acʹa·thite.

10405.label: 1 Chronicles 4:20
10405.text: And the sons of Shiʹmon were Amʹnon and Rinʹnah, Ben-haʹnan and Tiʹlon. And the sons of Ishʹi were Zoʹheth and Ben-zoʹheth.

10406.label: 1 Chronicles 4:21
10406.text: The sons of Sheʹlah the son of Judah were Er the father of Leʹcah and Laʹa·dah the father of Ma·reʹshah and the families of the house of the workers of fine fabric of the house of Ash·beʹa;

10407.label: 1 Chronicles 4:22
10407.text: and Joʹkim and the men of Co·zeʹba and Joʹash and Saʹraph, who became owners of Moʹab·ite wives, and Jashʹu·bi-leʹhem. And the sayings are of old tradition.

10408.label: 1 Chronicles 4:23
10408.text: They were the potters and the inhabitants of Ne·taʹim and Ge·deʹrah. It was with the king in his work that they dwelt there.

10409.label: 1 Chronicles 4:24
10409.text: The sons of Simʹe·on were Nemʹu·el and Jaʹmin, Jaʹrib, Zeʹrah, Shaʹul,

10410.label: 1 Chronicles 4:25
10410.text: Shalʹlum his son, Mibʹsam his son, Mishʹma his son.

10411.label: 1 Chronicles 4:26
10411.text: And the sons of Mishʹma were Hamʹmu·el his son, Zacʹcur his son, Shimʹe·i his son.

10412.label: 1 Chronicles 4:27
10412.text: And Shimʹe·i had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers did not have many sons, and none of their families had as many as the sons of Judah.

10413.label: 1 Chronicles 4:28
10413.text: And they continued to dwell in Beʹer-sheʹba and Mo·laʹdah and Haʹzar-shuʹal

10414.label: 1 Chronicles 4:29
10414.text: and in Bilʹhah and in Eʹzem and in Toʹlad

10415.label: 1 Chronicles 4:30
10415.text: and in Be·thuʹel and in Horʹmah and in Zikʹlag

10416.label: 1 Chronicles 4:31
10416.text: and in Beth-marʹca·both and in Haʹzar-suʹsim and in Beth-birʹi and in Shaʹa·raʹim. These were their cities down till David reigned.

10417.label: 1 Chronicles 4:32
10417.text: And their settlements were Eʹtam and Aʹin, Rimʹmon and Toʹchen and Aʹshan, five cities.

10418.label: 1 Chronicles 4:33
10418.text: And all their settlements that were all around these cities were as far as Baʹal. These were their dwelling places and their genealogical enrollments for them.

10419.label: 1 Chronicles 4:34
10419.text: And Me·shoʹbab and Jamʹlech and Joʹshah the son of Am·a·ziʹah,

10420.label: 1 Chronicles 4:35
10420.text: and Joel and Jeʹhu the son of Josh·i·biʹah the son of Se·raiʹah the son of Asʹi·el,

10421.label: 1 Chronicles 4:36
10421.text: and Eli·o·eʹnai and Ja·a·koʹbah and Jesh·o·haiʹah and A·saiʹah and Adʹi·el and Je·simʹi·el and Be·naiʹah,

10422.label: 1 Chronicles 4:37
10422.text: and Ziʹza the son of Shiʹphi the son of Alʹlon the son of Je·daʹiah the son of Shimʹri the son of She·maiʹah.

10423.label: 1 Chronicles 4:38
10423.text: These who came in by names were the chieftains among their families, and the household itself of their forefathers increased in multitude.

10424.label: 1 Chronicles 4:39
10424.text: And they proceeded to go to the entryway of Geʹdor, clear to the east of the valley, to look for pasturage for their flocks.

10425.label: 1 Chronicles 4:40
10425.text: Eventually they found fat and good pasturage, and the land was quite wide and having no disturbance but at ease; for those dwelling there in former times were of Ham.

10426.label: 1 Chronicles 4:41
10426.text: And these written down by [their] names proceeded to come in in the days of Hez·e·kiʹah the king of Judah and strike down the tents of the Hamʹites and the Me·uʹnim that were to be found there, so that they devoted them to destruction down to this day; and they began to dwell in their place, because there was pasturage for their flocks there.

10427.label: 1 Chronicles 4:42
10427.text: And from them there were some of the sons of Simʹe·on that went to Mount Seʹir, five hundred men, with Pel·a·tiʹah and Ne·a·riʹah and Re·phaʹiah and Uzʹzi·el the sons of Ishʹi at their head.

10428.label: 1 Chronicles 4:43
10428.text: And they proceeded to strike down the remnant that had escaped of Amʹa·lek, and they continued to dwell there down to this day.

10429.label: 1 Chronicles 5:1
10429.text: And the sons of Reuʹben the firstborn of Israel—for he was the firstborn; but for his profaning the lounge of his father his right as firstborn was given to the sons of Joseph the son of Israel, so that he was not to be enrolled genealogically for the right of the firstborn.

10430.label: 1 Chronicles 5:2
10430.text: For Judah himself proved to be superior among his brothers, and the one for leader was from him; but the right as firstborn was Joseph’s —

10431.label: 1 Chronicles 5:3
10431.text: the sons of Reuʹben the firstborn of Israel were Haʹnoch and Palʹlu, Hezʹron and Carʹmi.

10432.label: 1 Chronicles 5:4
10432.text: The sons of Joel were She·maiʹah his son, Gog his son, Shimʹe·i his son,

10433.label: 1 Chronicles 5:5
10433.text: Miʹcah his son, Re·aʹiah his son, Baʹal his son,

10434.label: 1 Chronicles 5:6
10434.text: Be·erʹah his son, whom Tilʹgath-pil·neʹser the king of As·syrʹi·a took into exile, he being a chieftain of the Reuʹben·ites.

10435.label: 1 Chronicles 5:7
10435.text: And his brothers by their families in the genealogical enrollment by their descendants were, as the head, Je·iʹel, and Zech·a·riʹah,

10436.label: 1 Chronicles 5:8
10436.text: and Beʹla the son of Aʹzaz the son of Sheʹma the son of Joel —he was dwelling in A·roʹer and as far as Neʹbo and Baʹal-meʹon.

10437.label: 1 Chronicles 5:9
10437.text: Even to the east he dwelt as far as where one enters the wilderness at the river Eu·phraʹtes, for their livestock itself had become numerous in the land of Gilʹe·ad.

10438.label: 1 Chronicles 5:10
10438.text: And in the days of Saul they made war upon the Hagʹrites, who came to fall by their hand; and so they dwelt in their tents throughout all the country east of Gilʹe·ad.

10439.label: 1 Chronicles 5:11
10439.text: As for the sons of Gad in front of them, they dwelt in the land of Baʹshan as far as Salʹe·cah.

10440.label: 1 Chronicles 5:12
10440.text: Joel was the head, and Shaʹpham the second, and Jaʹnai and Shaʹphat in Baʹshan.

10441.label: 1 Chronicles 5:13
10441.text: And their brothers belonging to the house of their forefathers were Miʹcha·el and Me·shulʹlam and Sheʹba and Joʹrai and Jaʹcan and Ziʹa and Eʹber, seven.

10442.label: 1 Chronicles 5:14
10442.text: These were the sons of Abʹi·ha·il the son of Huʹri, the son of Ja·roʹah, the son of Gilʹe·ad, the son of Miʹcha·el, the son of Je·shishʹai, the son of Jahʹdo, the son of Buz;

10443.label: 1 Chronicles 5:15
10443.text: Aʹhi the son of Abʹdi·el, the son of Guʹni, head of the house of their forefathers.

10444.label: 1 Chronicles 5:16
10444.text: And they continued to dwell in Gilʹe·ad, in Baʹshan and in its dependent towns and in all the pasture grounds of Sharʹon as far as their terminations.

10445.label: 1 Chronicles 5:17
10445.text: They were all of them enrolled genealogically in the days of Joʹtham the king of Judah and in the days of Jer·o·boʹam the king of Israel.

10446.label: 1 Chronicles 5:18
10446.text: As for the sons of Reuʹben and the Gadʹites and the half tribe of Ma·nasʹseh; of those who were valiant fellows, men carrying shield and sword and bending the bow and trained in war, there were forty-four thousand seven hundred and sixty going out to the army.

10447.label: 1 Chronicles 5:19
10447.text: And they began to make war upon the Hagʹrites, and Jeʹtur and Naʹphish and Noʹdab.

10448.label: 1 Chronicles 5:20
10448.text: And they came to be helped against them, so that the Hagʹrites and all those who were with them were given into their hand, for it was to God that they called for aid in the war, and he let himself be entreated in their favor because they trusted in him.

10449.label: 1 Chronicles 5:21
10449.text: And they got to take captive their livestock, their camels fifty thousand, and sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and asses two thousand, and human souls a hundred thousand.

10450.label: 1 Chronicles 5:22
10450.text: For there were many that had fallen slain, because it was on the part of the [true] God that the fighting was. And they continued to dwell in their place down to the time of the exile.

10451.label: 1 Chronicles 5:23
10451.text: As for the sons of the half tribe of Ma·nasʹseh, they dwelt in the land from Baʹshan to Baʹal-herʹmon and Seʹnir and Mount Herʹmon. They themselves became numerous.

10452.label: 1 Chronicles 5:24
10452.text: And these were the heads of the house of their forefathers: Eʹpher and Ishʹi and Eʹli·el and Azʹri·el and Jeremiah and Hod·a·viʹah and Jahʹdi·el, men that were valiant, mighty fellows, men of fame, heads of the house of their forefathers.

10453.label: 1 Chronicles 5:25
10453.text: And they began to act unfaithfully toward the God of their forefathers and went having immoral intercourse with the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God had annihilated from before them.

10454.label: 1 Chronicles 5:26
10454.text: Consequently the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul the king of As·syrʹi·a even the spirit of Tilʹgath-pil·neʹser the king of As·syrʹi·a, so that he took into exile those of the Reuʹben·ites and of the Gadʹites and of the half tribe of Ma·nasʹseh and brought them to Haʹlah and Haʹbor and Haʹra and the river Goʹzan [to continue] until this day.

10455.label: 1 Chronicles 6:1
10455.text: The sons of Leʹvi were Gerʹshon, Koʹhath and Me·rarʹi.

10456.label: 1 Chronicles 6:2
10456.text: And the sons of Koʹhath were Amʹram, Izʹhar and Heʹbron and Uzʹzi·el.

10457.label: 1 Chronicles 6:3
10457.text: And the sons of Amʹram were Aaron and Moses, and there was Mirʹi·am. And the sons of Aaron were Naʹdab and A·biʹhu, El·e·aʹzar and Ithʹa·mar.

10458.label: 1 Chronicles 6:4
10458.text: As for El·e·aʹzar, he became father to Phinʹe·has. Phinʹe·has himself became father to Ab·i·shuʹa.

10459.label: 1 Chronicles 6:5
10459.text: Ab·i·shuʹa, in turn, became father to Bukʹki; Bukʹki, in turn, became father to Uzʹzi.

10460.label: 1 Chronicles 6:6
10460.text: Uzʹzi, in turn, became father to Zer·a·hiʹah; Zer·a·hiʹah, in turn, became father to Me·raʹioth.

10461.label: 1 Chronicles 6:7
10461.text: Me·raʹioth himself became father to Am·a·riʹah; Am·a·riʹah, in turn, became father to A·hiʹtub.

10462.label: 1 Chronicles 6:8
10462.text: A·hiʹtub, in turn, became father to Zaʹdok; Zaʹdok, in turn, became father to A·himʹa·az.

10463.label: 1 Chronicles 6:9
10463.text: A·himʹa·az, in turn, became father to Az·a·riʹah. Az·a·riʹah, in turn, became father to Jo·haʹnan.

10464.label: 1 Chronicles 6:10
10464.text: Jo·haʹnan, in turn, became father to Az·a·riʹah. He was the one that acted as priest in the house that Solʹo·mon built in Jerusalem.

10465.label: 1 Chronicles 6:11
10465.text: And Az·a·riʹah came to be father to Am·a·riʹah. Am·a·riʹah, in turn, became father to A·hiʹtub.

10466.label: 1 Chronicles 6:12
10466.text: A·hiʹtub, in turn, became father to Zaʹdok. Zaʹdok, in turn, became father to Shalʹlum.

10467.label: 1 Chronicles 6:13
10467.text: Shalʹlum, in turn, became father to Hil·kiʹah. Hil·kiʹah, in turn, became father to Az·a·riʹah.

10468.label: 1 Chronicles 6:14
10468.text: Az·a·riʹah, in turn, became father to Se·raiʹah. Se·raiʹah, in turn, became father to Je·hozʹa·dak.

10469.label: 1 Chronicles 6:15
10469.text: And Je·hozʹa·dak it was that went away when Jehovah took Judah and Jerusalem into exile by the hand of Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar.

10470.label: 1 Chronicles 6:16
10470.text: The sons of Leʹvi were Gerʹshom, Koʹhath and Me·rarʹi.

10471.label: 1 Chronicles 6:17
10471.text: And these are the names of the sons of Gerʹshom: Libʹni and Shimʹe·i.

10472.label: 1 Chronicles 6:18
10472.text: And the sons of Koʹhath were Amʹram and Izʹhar and Heʹbron and Uzʹzi·el.

10473.label: 1 Chronicles 6:19
10473.text: The sons of Me·rarʹi were Mahʹli and Muʹshi. And these were the families of the Levites by their forefathers:

10474.label: 1 Chronicles 6:20
10474.text: Of Gerʹshom, Libʹni his son, Jaʹhath his son, Zimʹmah his son,

10475.label: 1 Chronicles 6:21
10475.text: Joʹah his son, Idʹdo his son, Zeʹrah his son, Je·athʹe·rai his son.

10476.label: 1 Chronicles 6:22
10476.text: The sons of Koʹhath were Am·minʹa·dab his son, Koʹrah his son, Asʹsir his son,

10477.label: 1 Chronicles 6:23
10477.text: El·kaʹnah his son and E·biʹa·saph his son and Asʹsir his son;

10478.label: 1 Chronicles 6:24
10478.text: Taʹhath his son, U·riʹel his son, Uz·ziʹah his son, and Shaʹul his son.

10479.label: 1 Chronicles 6:25
10479.text: And the sons of El·kaʹnah were A·maʹsai and A·hiʹmoth.

10480.label: 1 Chronicles 6:26
10480.text: As for El·kaʹnah, the sons of El·kaʹnah were Zoʹphai his son and Naʹhath his son,

10481.label: 1 Chronicles 6:27
10481.text: E·liʹab his son, Je·roʹham his son, El·kaʹnah his son.

10482.label: 1 Chronicles 6:28
10482.text: And the sons of Samuel were the firstborn [Joel] and the second A·biʹjah.

10483.label: 1 Chronicles 6:29
10483.text: The sons of Me·rarʹi were Mahʹli, Libʹni his son, Shimʹe·i his son, Uzʹzah his son,

10484.label: 1 Chronicles 6:30
10484.text: Shimʹe·a his son, Hag·giʹah his son, A·saiʹah his son.

10485.label: 1 Chronicles 6:31
10485.text: And these were the ones to whom David gave positions for the direction of the singing at the house of Jehovah after the Ark had a resting-place.

10486.label: 1 Chronicles 6:32
10486.text: And they came to be ministers in the singing before the tabernacle of the tent of meeting until Solʹo·mon built the house of Jehovah in Jerusalem; and they kept attending upon their service according to their commission.

10487.label: 1 Chronicles 6:33
10487.text: And these were those in attendance and also their sons: Of the sons of the Koʹhath·ites Heʹman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,

10488.label: 1 Chronicles 6:34
10488.text: the son of El·kaʹnah, the son of Je·roʹham, the son of Eʹli·el, the son of Toʹah,

10489.label: 1 Chronicles 6:35
10489.text: the son of Zuph, the son of El·kaʹnah, the son of Maʹhath, the son of A·maʹsai,

10490.label: 1 Chronicles 6:36
10490.text: the son of El·kaʹnah, the son of Joel, the son of Az·a·riʹah, the son of Zeph·a·niʹah,

10491.label: 1 Chronicles 6:37
10491.text: the son of Taʹhath, the son of Asʹsir, the son of E·biʹa·saph, the son of Koʹrah,

10492.label: 1 Chronicles 6:38
10492.text: the son of Izʹhar, the son of Koʹhath, the son of Leʹvi, the son of Israel.

10493.label: 1 Chronicles 6:39
10493.text: As for his brother Aʹsaph, who was attending at his right, Aʹsaph was the son of Ber·e·chiʹah, the son of Shimʹe·a,

10494.label: 1 Chronicles 6:40
10494.text: the son of Miʹcha·el, the son of Ba·a·seʹiah, the son of Mal·chiʹjah,

10495.label: 1 Chronicles 6:41
10495.text: the son of Ethʹni, the son of Zeʹrah, the son of A·daiʹah,

10496.label: 1 Chronicles 6:42
10496.text: the son of Eʹthan, the son of Zimʹmah, the son of Shimʹe·i,

10497.label: 1 Chronicles 6:43
10497.text: the son of Jaʹhath, the son of Gerʹshom, the son of Leʹvi.

10498.label: 1 Chronicles 6:44
10498.text: As regards the sons of Me·rarʹi their brothers on the left hand, there was Eʹthan the son of Kishʹi, the son of Abʹdi, the son of Malʹluch,

10499.label: 1 Chronicles 6:45
10499.text: the son of Hash·a·biʹah, the son of Am·a·ziʹah, the son of Hil·kiʹah,

10500.label: 1 Chronicles 6:46
10500.text: the son of Amʹzi, the son of Baʹni, the son of Sheʹmer,

10501.label: 1 Chronicles 6:47
10501.text: the son of Mahʹli, the son of Muʹshi, the son of Me·rarʹi, the son of Leʹvi.

10502.label: 1 Chronicles 6:48
10502.text: And their brothers the Levites were the ones given for all the service of the tabernacle of the house of the [true] God.

10503.label: 1 Chronicles 6:49
10503.text: And Aaron and his sons were making sacrificial smoke upon the altar of burnt offering and upon the altar of incense for all the work of the most holy things and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of the [true] God had commanded.

10504.label: 1 Chronicles 6:50
10504.text: And these were the sons of Aaron: El·e·aʹzar his son, Phinʹe·has his son, Ab·i·shuʹa his son,

10505.label: 1 Chronicles 6:51
10505.text: Bukʹki his son, Uzʹzi his son, Zer·a·hiʹah his son,

10506.label: 1 Chronicles 6:52
10506.text: Me·raʹioth his son, Am·a·riʹah his son, A·hiʹtub his son,

10507.label: 1 Chronicles 6:53
10507.text: Zaʹdok his son, A·himʹa·az his son.

10508.label: 1 Chronicles 6:54
10508.text: And these were their dwelling places by their walled camps in their territory, for the sons of Aaron belonging to the family of the Koʹhath·ites, for the lot had come to be theirs.

10509.label: 1 Chronicles 6:55
10509.text: Accordingly they gave them Heʹbron in the land of Judah, with its pasture grounds all around it.

10510.label: 1 Chronicles 6:56
10510.text: And the field of the city and its settlements they gave to Caʹleb the son of Je·phunʹneh.

10511.label: 1 Chronicles 6:57
10511.text: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, Heʹbron, and Libʹnah with its pasture grounds and Jatʹtir and Esh·te·moʹa with its pasture grounds,

10512.label: 1 Chronicles 6:58
10512.text: and Hiʹlen with its pasture grounds, Deʹbir with its pasture grounds,

10513.label: 1 Chronicles 6:59
10513.text: and Aʹshan with its pasture grounds and Beth-sheʹmesh with its pasture grounds;

10514.label: 1 Chronicles 6:60
10514.text: and from the tribe of Benjamin Geʹba with its pasture grounds and Alʹe·meth with its pasture grounds and Anʹa·thoth with its pasture grounds. All their cities were thirteen cities among their families.

10515.label: 1 Chronicles 6:61
10515.text: And to the sons of Koʹhath that were left over [they gave] from the family of the tribe, from the half tribe, the half of Ma·nasʹseh, by the lot ten cities.

10516.label: 1 Chronicles 6:62
10516.text: And to the sons of Gerʹshom by their families [they gave] from the tribe of Isʹsa·char and from the tribe of Ashʹer and from the tribe of Naphʹta·li and from the tribe of Ma·nasʹseh in Baʹshan, thirteen cities.

10517.label: 1 Chronicles 6:63
10517.text: To the sons of Me·rarʹi by their families [they gave] from the tribe of Reuʹben and from the tribe of Gad and from the tribe of Zebʹu·lun by the lot twelve cities.

10518.label: 1 Chronicles 6:64
10518.text: Thus the sons of Israel gave the Levites the cities with their pasture grounds.

10519.label: 1 Chronicles 6:65
10519.text: Furthermore, by the lot they gave from the tribe of the sons of Judah and from the tribe of the sons of Simʹe·on and from the tribe of the sons of Benjamin these cities, which they proceeded to call by names.

10520.label: 1 Chronicles 6:66
10520.text: And some of the families of the sons of Koʹhath came to have the cities of their territory from the tribe of Eʹphra·im.

10521.label: 1 Chronicles 6:67
10521.text: Accordingly they gave them the cities of refuge, Sheʹchem with its pasture grounds in the mountainous region of Eʹphra·im, and Geʹzer with its pasture grounds,

10522.label: 1 Chronicles 6:68
10522.text: and Jokʹme·am with its pasture grounds and Beth-hoʹron with its pasture grounds,

10523.label: 1 Chronicles 6:69
10523.text: and Aiʹja·lon with its pasture grounds and Gath-rimʹmon with its pasture grounds;

10524.label: 1 Chronicles 6:70
10524.text: and from half of the tribe of Ma·nasʹseh, Aʹner with its pasture grounds and Bilʹe·am with its pasture grounds, to the family of the sons of Koʹhath that were left over.

10525.label: 1 Chronicles 6:71
10525.text: And to the sons of Gerʹshom [they gave] from the family of the half tribe of Ma·nasʹseh Goʹlan in Baʹshan with its pasture grounds and Ashʹta·roth with its pasture grounds;

10526.label: 1 Chronicles 6:72
10526.text: and from the tribe of Isʹsa·char, Keʹdesh with its pasture grounds and Dabʹe·rath with its pasture grounds,

10527.label: 1 Chronicles 6:73
10527.text: and Raʹmoth with its pasture grounds and Aʹnem with its pasture grounds;

10528.label: 1 Chronicles 6:74
10528.text: and from the tribe of Ashʹer, Maʹshal with its pasture grounds and Abʹdon with its pasture grounds,

10529.label: 1 Chronicles 6:75
10529.text: and Huʹkok with its pasture grounds and Reʹhob with its pasture grounds;

10530.label: 1 Chronicles 6:76
10530.text: and from the tribe of Naphʹta·li, Keʹdesh in Galʹi·lee with its pasture grounds and Hamʹmon with its pasture grounds and Kir·i·a·thaʹim with its pasture grounds.

10531.label: 1 Chronicles 6:77
10531.text: To the sons of Me·rarʹi that were left over [they gave] from the tribe of Zebʹu·lun Rimʹmo·no with its pasture grounds, Taʹbor with its pasture grounds,

10532.label: 1 Chronicles 6:78
10532.text: and in the region of the Jordan at Jerʹi·cho to the east of the Jordan, from the tribe of Reuʹben, Beʹzer in the wilderness with its pasture grounds and Jaʹhaz with its pasture grounds,

10533.label: 1 Chronicles 6:79
10533.text: and Kedʹe·moth with its pasture grounds and Mephʹa·ath with its pasture grounds;

10534.label: 1 Chronicles 6:80
10534.text: and from the tribe of Gad, Raʹmoth in Gilʹe·ad with its pasture grounds and Ma·ha·naʹim with its pasture grounds,

10535.label: 1 Chronicles 6:81
10535.text: and Heshʹbon with its pasture grounds and Jaʹzer with its pasture grounds.

10536.label: 1 Chronicles 7:1
10536.text: Now the sons of Isʹsa·char were Toʹla and Puʹah, Jaʹshub and Shimʹron, four.

10537.label: 1 Chronicles 7:2
10537.text: And the sons of Toʹla were Uzʹzi and Re·phaʹiah and Jeʹri·el and Jahʹmai and Ibʹsam and She·muʹel, heads of the house of their forefathers. Of Toʹla there were valiant, mighty men, by their descendants. Their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.

10538.label: 1 Chronicles 7:3
10538.text: And the sons of Uzʹzi were Iz·ra·hiʹah; and the sons of Iz·ra·hiʹah were Miʹcha·el and O·ba·diʹah and Joel, Is·shiʹah, , five, all of them being heads.

10539.label: 1 Chronicles 7:4
10539.text: And with them by their descendants, according to the house of their forefathers, there were troops of the army for war, thirty-six thousand, for they had many wives and sons.

10540.label: 1 Chronicles 7:5
10540.text: And their brothers of all the families of Isʹsa·char were valiant, mighty men, eighty-seven thousand by the genealogical enrollment of them all.

10541.label: 1 Chronicles 7:6
10541.text: [The sons of] Benjamin were Beʹla and Beʹcher and Je·diʹa·el, three.

10542.label: 1 Chronicles 7:7
10542.text: And the sons of Beʹla were Ezʹbon and Uzʹzi and Uzʹzi·el and Jerʹi·moth and Iʹri, five, heads of the house of their forefathers, valiant, mighty men; and their genealogical enrollment was twenty-two thousand and thirty-four.

10543.label: 1 Chronicles 7:8
10543.text: And the sons of Beʹcher were Ze·miʹrah and Joʹash and E·li·eʹzer and Eli·o·eʹnai and Omʹri and Jerʹe·moth and A·biʹjah and Anʹa·thoth and Alʹe·meth, all these the sons of Beʹcher.

10544.label: 1 Chronicles 7:9
10544.text: And their genealogical enrollment by their descendants as respects the heads of the house of their forefathers, valiant, mighty men, was twenty thousand two hundred.

10545.label: 1 Chronicles 7:10
10545.text: And the sons of Je·diʹa·el were Bilʹhan; and the sons of Bilʹhan were Jeʹush and Benjamin and Eʹhud and Che·naʹa·nah and Zeʹthan and Tarʹshish and A·hishʹa·har.

10546.label: 1 Chronicles 7:11
10546.text: All these were the sons of Je·diʹa·el, according to the heads of their forefathers, valiant, mighty men, seventeen thousand two hundred going out to the army for war.

10547.label: 1 Chronicles 7:12
10547.text: And the Shupʹpim and the Hupʹpim were the sons of Ir; the Huʹshim were the sons of Aʹher.

10548.label: 1 Chronicles 7:13
10548.text: The sons of Naphʹta·li were Jahʹzi·el and Guʹni and Jeʹzer and Shalʹlum, the sons of Bilʹhah.

10549.label: 1 Chronicles 7:14
10549.text: The sons of Ma·nasʹseh were Asʹri·el, whom his Syrian concubine bore. (She bore Maʹchir the father of Gilʹe·ad.

10550.label: 1 Chronicles 7:15
10550.text: And Maʹchir himself took a wife for Hupʹpim and for Shupʹpim, and the name of his sister was Maʹa·cah.) And the name of the second was Ze·loʹphe·had, but Ze·loʹphe·had came to have daughters.

10551.label: 1 Chronicles 7:16
10551.text: In time Maʹa·cah, Maʹchir’s wife, bore a son and called his name Peʹresh; and the name of his brother was Sheʹresh; and his sons were Uʹlam and Reʹkem.

10552.label: 1 Chronicles 7:17
10552.text: And the sons of Uʹlam were Beʹdan. These were the sons of Gilʹe·ad the son of Maʹchir the son of Ma·nasʹseh.

10553.label: 1 Chronicles 7:18
10553.text: And his sister was Ham·moʹle·cheth. She gave birth to Ishʹhod and Abi-eʹzer and Mahʹlah.

10554.label: 1 Chronicles 7:19
10554.text: And the sons of She·miʹda came to be A·hiʹan and Sheʹchem and Likʹhi and A·niʹam.

10555.label: 1 Chronicles 7:20
10555.text: And the sons of Eʹphra·im were Shuʹthe·lah and Beʹred his son and Taʹhath his son and E·le·aʹdah his son and Taʹhath his son,

10556.label: 1 Chronicles 7:21
10556.text: and Zaʹbad his son and Shuʹthe·lah his son and Eʹzer and Eʹle·ad. And the men of Gath that were born in the land killed them because they came down to take their livestock.

10557.label: 1 Chronicles 7:22
10557.text: And Eʹphra·im their father carried on mourning for many days, and his brothers kept coming in to comfort him.

10558.label: 1 Chronicles 7:23
10558.text: Afterward he had relations with his wife, so that she became pregnant and gave birth to a son. But he called his name Be·riʹah, because it was with calamity that she happened to be in his house.

10559.label: 1 Chronicles 7:24
10559.text: And his daughter was Sheʹe·rah, and she got to build Beth-hoʹron, the lower and the upper, and Uzʹzen-sheʹe·rah.

10560.label: 1 Chronicles 7:25
10560.text: And there was Reʹphah his son, and Reʹsheph, and Teʹlah his son, and Taʹhan his son,

10561.label: 1 Chronicles 7:26
10561.text: Laʹdan his son, Am·miʹhud his son, E·lishʹa·ma his son,

10562.label: 1 Chronicles 7:27
10562.text: Nun his son, Je·hoshʹu·a his son.

10563.label: 1 Chronicles 7:28
10563.text: And their possession and their dwelling places were Bethʹel and its dependent towns and, to the east, Naʹa·ran and, to the west, Geʹzer and its dependent towns, and Sheʹchem and its dependent towns clear to Gaʹza and its dependent towns;

10564.label: 1 Chronicles 7:29
10564.text: and by the side of the sons of Ma·nasʹseh Beth-sheʹan and its dependent towns, Taʹa·nach and its dependent towns, Me·gidʹdo and its dependent towns, Dor and its dependent towns. In these the sons of Joseph the son of Israel dwelt.

10565.label: 1 Chronicles 7:30
10565.text: The sons of Ashʹer were Imʹnah and Ishʹvah and Ishʹvi and Be·riʹah; and Seʹrah was their sister.

10566.label: 1 Chronicles 7:31
10566.text: And the sons of Be·riʹah were Heʹber and Malʹchi·el, who was the father of Birʹza·ith.

10567.label: 1 Chronicles 7:32
10567.text: As for Heʹber, he became father to Japhʹlet and Shoʹmer and Hoʹtham, and to Shuʹa their sister.

10568.label: 1 Chronicles 7:33
10568.text: And the sons of Japhʹlet were Paʹsach and Bimʹhal and Ashʹvath. These were the sons of Japhʹlet.

10569.label: 1 Chronicles 7:34
10569.text: And the sons of Sheʹmer were Aʹhi and Rohʹgah, Je·hubʹbah and Aʹram.

10570.label: 1 Chronicles 7:35
10570.text: And the sons of Heʹlem his brother were Zoʹphah and Imʹna and Sheʹlesh and Aʹmal.

10571.label: 1 Chronicles 7:36
10571.text: The sons of Zoʹphah were Suʹah and Harʹne·pher and Shuʹal and Beʹri and Imʹrah,

10572.label: 1 Chronicles 7:37
10572.text: Beʹzer and Hod and Shamʹma and Shilʹshah and Ithʹran and Be·eʹra.

10573.label: 1 Chronicles 7:38
10573.text: And the sons of Jeʹther were Je·phunʹneh and Pisʹpah and Aʹra.

10574.label: 1 Chronicles 7:39
10574.text: And the sons of Ulʹla were Aʹrah and Hanʹni·el and Ri·ziʹa.

10575.label: 1 Chronicles 7:40
10575.text: All these were the sons of Ashʹer, heads of the house of the forefathers, select, valiant, mighty men, heads of the chieftains; and their genealogical enrollment was in the army in the war. Their number was twenty-six thousand men.

10576.label: 1 Chronicles 8:1
10576.text: As for Benjamin, he became father to Beʹla his firstborn, Ashʹbel the second and A·harʹah the third,

10577.label: 1 Chronicles 8:2
10577.text: Noʹhah the fourth and Raʹpha the fifth.

10578.label: 1 Chronicles 8:3
10578.text: And Beʹla came to have sons, Adʹdar and Geʹra and A·biʹhud,

10579.label: 1 Chronicles 8:4
10579.text: and Ab·i·shuʹa and Naʹa·man and A·hoʹah,

10580.label: 1 Chronicles 8:5
10580.text: and Geʹra and She·phuʹphan and Huʹram.

10581.label: 1 Chronicles 8:6
10581.text: And these were the sons of Eʹhud. These were the heads of [the houses of] forefathers belonging to the inhabitants of Geʹba, and they proceeded to take them into exile at Manʹa·hath.

10582.label: 1 Chronicles 8:7
10582.text: And Naʹa·man and A·hiʹjah; and Geʹra—he was the one that took them into exile, and he became father to Uzʹza and A·hiʹhud.

10583.label: 1 Chronicles 8:8
10583.text: As for Sha·ha·raʹim, he became father to [children] in the field of Moʹab after he sent them away. Huʹshim and Baʹa·ra were his wives.

10584.label: 1 Chronicles 8:9
10584.text: And by Hoʹdesh his wife he came to be father to Joʹbab and Zibʹi·a and Meʹsha and Malʹcam,

10585.label: 1 Chronicles 8:10
10585.text: and Jeʹuz and Sa·chiʹa and Mirʹmah. These were his sons, heads of [the houses of] forefathers.

10586.label: 1 Chronicles 8:11
10586.text: And by Huʹshim he became father to A·biʹtub and El·paʹal.

10587.label: 1 Chronicles 8:12
10587.text: And the sons of El·paʹal were Eʹber and Miʹsham and Sheʹmed, who built Oʹno and Lod and its dependent towns,

10588.label: 1 Chronicles 8:13
10588.text: and Be·riʹah and Sheʹma. These were heads of [the houses of] forefathers, belonging to the inhabitants of Aiʹja·lon. These were the ones that chased away the inhabitants of Gath.

10589.label: 1 Chronicles 8:14
10589.text: And [there were] A·hiʹo, Shaʹshak and Jerʹe·moth,

10590.label: 1 Chronicles 8:15
10590.text: and Zeb·a·diʹah and Aʹrad and Eʹder,

10591.label: 1 Chronicles 8:16
10591.text: and Miʹcha·el and Ishʹpah and Joʹha, the sons of Be·riʹah,

10592.label: 1 Chronicles 8:17
10592.text: and Zeb·a·diʹah and Me·shulʹlam and Hizʹki and Heʹber,

10593.label: 1 Chronicles 8:18
10593.text: and Ishʹme·rai and Iz·liʹah and Joʹbab, the sons of El·paʹal,

10594.label: 1 Chronicles 8:19
10594.text: and Jaʹkim and Zichʹri and Zabʹdi,

10595.label: 1 Chronicles 8:20
10595.text: and E·li·eʹnai and Zilʹle·thai and Eʹli·el,

10596.label: 1 Chronicles 8:21
10596.text: and A·daiʹah and Be·raʹiah and Shimʹrath, the sons of Shimʹe·i,

10597.label: 1 Chronicles 8:22
10597.text: and Ishʹpan and Eʹber and Eʹli·el,

10598.label: 1 Chronicles 8:23
10598.text: and Abʹdon and Zichʹri and Haʹnan,

10599.label: 1 Chronicles 8:24
10599.text: and Han·a·niʹah and Eʹlam and An·tho·thiʹjah,

10600.label: 1 Chronicles 8:25
10600.text: and Iph·deʹiah and Pe·nuʹel, the sons of Shaʹshak,

10601.label: 1 Chronicles 8:26
10601.text: and Shamʹshe·rai and She·ha·riʹah and Ath·a·liʹah,

10602.label: 1 Chronicles 8:27
10602.text: and Ja·a·re·shiʹah and E·liʹjah and Zichʹri, the sons of Je·roʹham.

10603.label: 1 Chronicles 8:28
10603.text: These were heads of [the houses of] forefathers by their descendants, headmen. These were the ones that dwelt in Jerusalem.

10604.label: 1 Chronicles 8:29
10604.text: And it was in Gibʹe·on that the father of Gibʹe·on, [Je·iʹel,] dwelt, and his wife’s name was Maʹa·cah.

10605.label: 1 Chronicles 8:30
10605.text: And his son, the firstborn, was Abʹdon, and Zur and Kish and Baʹal and Naʹdab,

10606.label: 1 Chronicles 8:31
10606.text: and Geʹdor and A·hiʹo and Zeʹcher.

10607.label: 1 Chronicles 8:32
10607.text: As for Mikʹloth, he became father to Shimʹe·ah. And these really were the ones that dwelt in front of their brothers in Jerusalem along with brothers of theirs.

10608.label: 1 Chronicles 8:33
10608.text: As for Ner, he became father to Kish; Kish, in turn, became father to Saul; Saul, in turn, became father to Jonʹa·than and Malʹchi-shuʹa and A·binʹa·dab and Esh·baʹal.

10609.label: 1 Chronicles 8:34
10609.text: And Jonʹa·than’s son was Merʹib-baʹal. As for Merʹib-baʹal, he became father to Miʹcah.

10610.label: 1 Chronicles 8:35
10610.text: And the sons of Miʹcah were Piʹthon and Melʹech and Ta·reʹa and Aʹhaz.

10611.label: 1 Chronicles 8:36
10611.text: As for Aʹhaz, he became father to Je·hoʹad·dah; Je·hoʹad·dah, in turn, became father to Alʹe·meth and Azʹma·veth and Zimʹri. Zimʹri, in turn, became father to Moʹza;

10612.label: 1 Chronicles 8:37
10612.text: Moʹza, in turn, became father to Binʹe·a, Raʹphah his son, El·e·aʹsah his son, Aʹzel his son.

10613.label: 1 Chronicles 8:38
10613.text: And Aʹzel had six sons, and these were their names: Az·riʹkam, Boʹche·ru and Ishʹma·el and She·a·riʹah and O·ba·diʹah and Haʹnan. All these were the sons of Aʹzel.

10614.label: 1 Chronicles 8:39
10614.text: And the sons of Eʹshek his brother were Uʹlam his firstborn, Jeʹush the second and E·liphʹe·let the third.

10615.label: 1 Chronicles 8:40
10615.text: And the sons of Uʹlam came to be valiant, mighty men, bending the bow, and having many sons and grandsons, a hundred and fifty. All these were from the sons of Benjamin.

10616.label: 1 Chronicles 9:1
10616.text: As for all Israelites, they were enrolled genealogically; and there they are written in the Book of the Kings of Israel. And Judah itself was taken into exile at Babylon for their unfaithfulness.

10617.label: 1 Chronicles 9:2
10617.text: And the first inhabitants that were in their possession in their cities were the Israelites, the priests, the Levites and the Nethʹi·nim.

10618.label: 1 Chronicles 9:3
10618.text: And in Jerusalem there dwelt some of the sons of Judah and some of the sons of Benjamin and some of the sons of Eʹphra·im and of Ma·nasʹseh:

10619.label: 1 Chronicles 9:4
10619.text: Uʹthai the son of Am·miʹhud the son of Omʹri the son of Imʹri the son of Baʹni, of the sons of Peʹrez the son of Judah.

10620.label: 1 Chronicles 9:5
10620.text: And of the Shiʹlo·nites, A·saiʹah the firstborn and his sons.

10621.label: 1 Chronicles 9:6
10621.text: And of the sons of Zeʹrah, Je·uʹel, and six hundred and ninety brothers of theirs.

10622.label: 1 Chronicles 9:7
10622.text: And of the sons of Benjamin, Salʹlu the son of Me·shulʹlam the son of Hod·a·viʹah the son of Has·se·nuʹah,

10623.label: 1 Chronicles 9:8
10623.text: and Ib·neʹiah the son of Je·roʹham, and Eʹlah the son of Uzʹzi the son of Michʹri, and Me·shulʹlam the son of Sheph·a·tiʹah the son of Reuʹel the son of Ib·niʹjah.

10624.label: 1 Chronicles 9:9
10624.text: And the brothers of theirs by their descendants were nine hundred and fifty-six. All these were men that were heads of the fathers by the house of their forefathers.

10625.label: 1 Chronicles 9:10
10625.text: And of the priests there were Je·daʹiah and Je·hoiʹa·rib and Jaʹchin,

10626.label: 1 Chronicles 9:11
10626.text: and Az·a·riʹah the son of Hil·kiʹah the son of Me·shulʹlam the son of Zaʹdok the son of Me·raʹioth the son of A·hiʹtub, a leader of the house of the [true] God,

10627.label: 1 Chronicles 9:12
10627.text: and A·daiʹah the son of Je·roʹham the son of Pashʹhur the son of Mal·chiʹjah, and Maʹa·sai the son of Adʹi·el the son of Jahʹze·rah the son of Me·shulʹlam the son of Me·shilʹle·mith the son of Imʹmer,

10628.label: 1 Chronicles 9:13
10628.text: and their brothers, heads of the house of their forefathers, a thousand seven hundred and sixty, mighty men of ability for the work of the service of the house of the [true] God.

10629.label: 1 Chronicles 9:14
10629.text: And of the Levites there were She·maiʹah the son of Hasʹshub the son of Az·riʹkam the son of Hash·a·biʹah from the sons of Me·rarʹi;

10630.label: 1 Chronicles 9:15
10630.text: and Bak·bakʹkar, Heʹresh and Gaʹlal, and Mat·ta·niʹah the son of Miʹca the son of Zichʹri the son of Aʹsaph,

10631.label: 1 Chronicles 9:16
10631.text: and O·ba·diʹah the son of She·maiʹah the son of Gaʹlal the son of Je·duʹthun, and Ber·e·chiʹah the son of Aʹsa the son of El·kaʹnah, who was dwelling in the settlements of the Ne·tophʹa·thites.

10632.label: 1 Chronicles 9:17
10632.text: And the gatekeepers were Shalʹlum and Akʹkub and Talʹmon and A·hiʹman and their brother Shalʹlum the head,

10633.label: 1 Chronicles 9:18
10633.text: and up till then he was in the king’s gate to the east. These were the gatekeepers of the camps of the sons of Leʹvi.

10634.label: 1 Chronicles 9:19
10634.text: And Shalʹlum the son of Koʹre the son of E·biʹa·saph the son of Koʹrah and his brothers of the house of his father the Koʹrah·ites, over the work of the service, the doorkeepers of the tent, and their fathers over the camp of Jehovah, the keepers of the entryway.

10635.label: 1 Chronicles 9:20
10635.text: And it was Phinʹe·has the son of El·e·aʹzar that happened to be leader over them in the past. Jehovah was with him.

10636.label: 1 Chronicles 9:21
10636.text: Zech·a·riʹah the son of Me·shel·e·miʹah was the gatekeeper of the entrance of the tent of meeting.

10637.label: 1 Chronicles 9:22
10637.text: All of them who were selected as gatekeepers at the thresholds were two hundred and twelve. They were in their settlements by their genealogical enrollment. These David and Samuel the seer ordained in their office of trust.

10638.label: 1 Chronicles 9:23
10638.text: And they and their sons were over the gates of the house of Jehovah, even the house of the tent, for guard service.

10639.label: 1 Chronicles 9:24
10639.text: It was to the four directions that the gatekeepers came to be, to the east, to the west, to the north and to the south.

10640.label: 1 Chronicles 9:25
10640.text: And their brothers in their settlements were to come in for seven days, from time to time, along with these.

10641.label: 1 Chronicles 9:26
10641.text: For in office of trust there were four mighty men of the gatekeepers. They were Levites, and they proved to be in charge of the dining rooms and of the treasures of the house of the [true] God.

10642.label: 1 Chronicles 9:27
10642.text: And all around the house of the [true] God they would spend the night; for guard service was upon them, and they were in charge of the key, even [to open up] from morning to morning.

10643.label: 1 Chronicles 9:28
10643.text: And some of them were in charge of the utensils of the service, for it was by number that they would bring them in and it was by number that they would take them out.

10644.label: 1 Chronicles 9:29
10644.text: And some of them were men appointed over the utensils and over all the holy utensils and over the fine flour and the wine and the oil and the frankincense and the balsam oil.

10645.label: 1 Chronicles 9:30
10645.text: And some of the sons of the priests were makers of the ointment mixture of balsam oil.

10646.label: 1 Chronicles 9:31
10646.text: And Mat·ti·thiʹah of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shalʹlum the Koʹrah·ite, was in the office of trust over the things baked in pans.

10647.label: 1 Chronicles 9:32
10647.text: And some of the sons of the Koʹhath·ites, their brothers, were in charge of the layer bread, to prepare it sabbath by sabbath.

10648.label: 1 Chronicles 9:33
10648.text: And these were the singers, the heads of the fathers of the Levites in the dining rooms, those set free from duty; for by day and by night it was their responsibility to be in the work.

10649.label: 1 Chronicles 9:34
10649.text: These were the heads of the fathers of the Levites by their descendants, headmen. These were the ones that dwelt in Jerusalem.

10650.label: 1 Chronicles 9:35
10650.text: And in Gibʹe·on was where the father of Gibʹe·on, Je·iʹel, dwelt. And his wife’s name was Maʹa·cah.

10651.label: 1 Chronicles 9:36
10651.text: And his son, the firstborn, was Abʹdon, and Zur and Kish and Baʹal and Ner and Naʹdab,

10652.label: 1 Chronicles 9:37
10652.text: and Geʹdor and A·hiʹo and Zech·a·riʹah and Mikʹloth.

10653.label: 1 Chronicles 9:38
10653.text: As for Mikʹloth, he became father to Shimʹe·am. And it was really they that dwelt in front of their brothers in Jerusalem along with brothers of theirs.

10654.label: 1 Chronicles 9:39
10654.text: As for Ner, he became father to Kish; Kish, in turn, became father to Saul; Saul, in turn, became father to Jonʹa·than and Malʹchi-shuʹa and A·binʹa·dab and Esh·baʹal.

10655.label: 1 Chronicles 9:40
10655.text: And the son of Jonʹa·than was Merʹib-baʹal. As for Merʹib-baʹal, he became father to Miʹcah.

10656.label: 1 Chronicles 9:41
10656.text: And the sons of Miʹcah were Piʹthon and Melʹech and Tahrʹe·a [and Aʹhaz].

10657.label: 1 Chronicles 9:42
10657.text: As for Aʹhaz, he became father to Jaʹrah; Jaʹrah, in turn, became father to Alʹe·meth and Azʹma·veth and Zimʹri. Zimʹri, in turn, became father to Moʹza.

10658.label: 1 Chronicles 9:43
10658.text: As for Moʹza, he became father to Binʹe·a and Re·phaʹiah his son, El·e·aʹsah his son, Aʹzel his son.

10659.label: 1 Chronicles 9:44
10659.text: And Aʹzel had six sons, and these were their names: Az·riʹkam, Boʹche·ru and Ishʹma·el and She·a·riʹah and O·ba·diʹah and Haʹnan. These were the sons of Aʹzel.

10660.label: 1 Chronicles 10:1
10660.text: And the Phi·lisʹtines, for their part, made war upon Israel; and the men of Israel went fleeing from before the Phi·lisʹtines and kept falling slain in Mount Gil·boʹa.

10661.label: 1 Chronicles 10:2
10661.text: And the Phi·lisʹtines kept in close range of Saul and his sons; and the Phi·lisʹtines got to strike down Jonʹa·than and A·binʹa·dab and Malʹchi-shuʹa, sons of Saul.

10662.label: 1 Chronicles 10:3
10662.text: And the fighting became heavy against Saul; and those shooting with the bow finally found him, and he got wounded by the shooters.

10663.label: 1 Chronicles 10:4
10663.text: Then Saul said to his armor-bearer: “Draw your sword and run me through with it, that these uncircumcised men may not come and certainly deal abusively with me.” And his armor-bearer was unwilling, because he was very much afraid. So Saul took the sword and fell upon it.

10664.label: 1 Chronicles 10:5
10664.text: When his armor-bearer saw that Saul had died, then he too fell upon the sword and died.

10665.label: 1 Chronicles 10:6
10665.text: Thus Saul and three sons of his died, and all those of his house died together.

10666.label: 1 Chronicles 10:7
10666.text: When all the men of Israel that were in the low plain saw that they had fled and that Saul and his sons had died, then they began to leave their cities and flee; after which the Phi·lisʹtines came on in and took up dwelling in them.

10667.label: 1 Chronicles 10:8
10667.text: And it came about the next day that, when the Phi·lisʹtines came to strip the slain, they got to find Saul and his sons fallen upon Mount Gil·boʹa.

10668.label: 1 Chronicles 10:9
10668.text: And they proceeded to strip him and take off his head and his armor and send into the land of the Phi·lisʹtines all around to inform their idols and the people.

10669.label: 1 Chronicles 10:10
10669.text: Finally they put his armor in the house of their god, and his skull they fastened to the house of Daʹgon.

10670.label: 1 Chronicles 10:11
10670.text: And all those of Jaʹbesh in Gilʹe·ad got to hear of all that the Phi·lisʹtines had done to Saul.

10671.label: 1 Chronicles 10:12
10671.text: So all the valiant men rose up and carried off the corpse of Saul and the corpses of his sons and brought them to Jaʹbesh and buried their bones under the big tree in Jaʹbesh; and they went fasting for seven days.

10672.label: 1 Chronicles 10:13
10672.text: Thus Saul died for his unfaithfulness with which he had acted faithlessly against Jehovah concerning the word of Jehovah that he had not kept and also for asking of a spirit medium to make inquiry.

10673.label: 1 Chronicles 10:14
10673.text: And he did not inquire of Jehovah. Consequently he put him to death and turned the kingship over to David the son of Jesʹse.

10674.label: 1 Chronicles 11:1
10674.text: In time all the Israelites collected themselves together to David at Heʹbron, saying: “Look! We are your bone and your flesh.

10675.label: 1 Chronicles 11:2
10675.text: Both yesterday and previously, even while Saul happened to be king, you were the one leading Israel out and bringing it in; and Jehovah your God proceeded to say to you, ‘You yourself will shepherd my people Israel, and you yourself will become leader over my people Israel.’”

10676.label: 1 Chronicles 11:3
10676.text: So all the older men of Israel came to the king at Heʹbron and David concluded a covenant with them in Heʹbron before Jehovah; after which they anointed David as king over Israel, according to Jehovah’s word by means of Samuel.

10677.label: 1 Chronicles 11:4
10677.text: Later David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, that is to say, Jeʹbus, where the Jebʹu·sites were the inhabitants of the land.

10678.label: 1 Chronicles 11:5
10678.text: And the inhabitants of Jeʹbus began to say to David: “You will not come in here.” Just the same, David proceeded to capture the stronghold of Zion, that is to say, the City of David.

10679.label: 1 Chronicles 11:6
10679.text: So David said: “Anyone striking the Jebʹu·sites first, he will become head and prince.” And Joʹab the son of Ze·ruʹiah got to go up first, and he came to be head.

10680.label: 1 Chronicles 11:7
10680.text: And David took up dwelling in the place difficult to approach. That is why they called it the City of David.

10681.label: 1 Chronicles 11:8
10681.text: And he began to build the city all around, from the Mound even to the parts round about, but Joʹab himself brought to life the rest of the city.

10682.label: 1 Chronicles 11:9
10682.text: And David went on getting greater and greater, for Jehovah of armies was with him.

10683.label: 1 Chronicles 11:10
10683.text: Now these are the heads of the mighty men that belonged to David, holding strongly with him in his kingship together with all Israel, to make him king according to Jehovah’s word concerning Israel.

10684.label: 1 Chronicles 11:11
10684.text: And this is the list of the mighty men that belonged to David: Ja·shoʹbe·am the son of a Hachʹmon·ite, the head of the three. He was brandishing his spear over three hundred slain at one time.

10685.label: 1 Chronicles 11:12
10685.text: And after him there was El·e·aʹzar the son of Doʹdo the A·hoʹhite. He was among the three mighty men.

10686.label: 1 Chronicles 11:13
10686.text: He it was that happened to be with David at Pas-damʹmim, where the Phi·lisʹtines had gathered themselves together for war. Now there happened to be a tract of the field full of barley, and the people, for their part, had fled because of the Phi·lisʹtines.

10687.label: 1 Chronicles 11:14
10687.text: But he took his stand in the middle of the tract and delivered it, and kept striking down the Phi·lisʹtines, so that Jehovah saved with a great salvation.

10688.label: 1 Chronicles 11:15
10688.text: And three of the thirty head ones proceeded to go down to the rock, to David at the cave of A·dulʹlam, while a camp of the Phi·lisʹtines was camping in the low plain of Rephʹa·im.

10689.label: 1 Chronicles 11:16
10689.text: And David was then in the place hard to approach; and a garrison of the Phi·lisʹtines was then in Bethʹle·hem.

10690.label: 1 Chronicles 11:17
10690.text: After a while David showed his craving and said: “O that I might have a drink of the water from the cistern of Bethʹle·hem, which is at the gate!”

10691.label: 1 Chronicles 11:18
10691.text: At that the three forced their way into the camp of the Phi·lisʹtines and drew water from the cistern of Bethʹle·hem, which is at the gate, and came carrying and bringing it to David. And David did not consent to drink it, but poured it out to Jehovah.

10692.label: 1 Chronicles 11:19
10692.text: And he went on to say: “It is unthinkable on my part, as regards my God, to do this! Is it the blood of these men that I should drink at the risk of their souls? For it was at the risk of their souls that they brought it.” And he did not consent to drink it. These are the things that the three mighty men did.

10693.label: 1 Chronicles 11:20
10693.text: As for A·bishʹai the brother of Joʹab, he himself became head of the three; and he was brandishing his spear over three hundred slain, and he had a reputation like the three.

10694.label: 1 Chronicles 11:21
10694.text: Of the three he was more distinguished than the two others, and he came to be a chief to them; and yet he did not come up to the [first] three.

10695.label: 1 Chronicles 11:22
10695.text: As for Be·naiʹah the son of Je·hoiʹa·da, the son of a valiant man, who did many deeds in Kabʹze·el, he himself struck down the two [sons] of Arʹi·el of Moʹab; and he himself descended and struck down a lion inside a waterpit in the day of snowfall.

10696.label: 1 Chronicles 11:23
10696.text: And he it was that struck down the Egyptian man, a man of extraordinary size, of five cubits. And in the hand of the Egyptian there was a spear like the beam of loom workers; yet he went on down to him with a rod and snatched the spear away from the Egyptian’s hand and killed him with his own spear.

10697.label: 1 Chronicles 11:24
10697.text: These things Be·naiʹah the son of Je·hoiʹa·da did, and he had a name among the three mighty men.

10698.label: 1 Chronicles 11:25
10698.text: Although he was more distinguished than the thirty, yet to the rank of the [first] three he did not come. However, David put him over his own bodyguard.

10699.label: 1 Chronicles 11:26
10699.text: As for the mighty men of the military forces, there were Asʹa·hel the brother of Joʹab, El·haʹnan the son of Doʹdo of Bethʹle·hem,

10700.label: 1 Chronicles 11:27
10700.text: Shamʹmoth the Haʹro·rite, Heʹlez the Pelʹo·nite,

10701.label: 1 Chronicles 11:28
10701.text: Iʹra the son of Ikʹkesh the Te·koʹite, Abi-eʹzer the Anʹa·thoth·ite,

10702.label: 1 Chronicles 11:29
10702.text: Sibʹbe·cai the Huʹshath·ite, Iʹlai the A·hoʹhite,

10703.label: 1 Chronicles 11:30
10703.text: Maʹha·rai the Ne·tophʹa·thite, Heʹled the son of Baʹa·nah the Ne·tophʹa·thite,

10704.label: 1 Chronicles 11:31
10704.text: Iʹthai the son of Riʹbai of Gibʹe·ah of the sons of Benjamin, Be·naiʹah the Pirʹa·thon·ite,

10705.label: 1 Chronicles 11:32
10705.text: Huʹrai from the torrent valleys of Gaʹash, A·biʹel the Arʹbath·ite,

10706.label: 1 Chronicles 11:33
10706.text: Azʹma·veth the Ba·haʹrum·ite, E·liʹah·ba the Sha·alʹbo·nite,

10707.label: 1 Chronicles 11:34
10707.text: the sons of Haʹshem the Giʹzo·nite, Jonʹa·than the son of Shaʹgee the Harʹa·rite,

10708.label: 1 Chronicles 11:35
10708.text: A·hiʹam the son of Saʹcar the Harʹa·rite, E·liʹphal the son of Ur,

10709.label: 1 Chronicles 11:36
10709.text: Heʹpher the Me·cheʹrath·ite, A·hiʹjah the Pelʹo·nite,

10710.label: 1 Chronicles 11:37
10710.text: Hezʹro the Carʹmel·ite, Naʹa·rai the son of Ezʹbai,

10711.label: 1 Chronicles 11:38
10711.text: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibʹhar the son of Hagʹri,

10712.label: 1 Chronicles 11:39
10712.text: Zeʹlek the Amʹmon·ite, Naʹha·rai the Be·rothʹite, the armor-bearer of Joʹab the son of Ze·ruʹiah,

10713.label: 1 Chronicles 11:40
10713.text: Iʹra the Ithʹrite, Gaʹreb the Ithʹrite,

10714.label: 1 Chronicles 11:41
10714.text: U·riʹah the Hitʹtite, Zaʹbad the son of Ahʹlai,

10715.label: 1 Chronicles 11:42
10715.text: Adʹi·na the son of Shiʹza the Reuʹben·ite, a head of the Reuʹben·ites, by whom there were thirty;

10716.label: 1 Chronicles 11:43
10716.text: Haʹnan the son of Maʹa·cah, and Joshʹa·phat the Mithʹnite,

10717.label: 1 Chronicles 11:44
10717.text: Uz·ziʹa the Ashʹte·rath·ite, Shaʹma and Je·iʹel, the sons of Hoʹtham the A·roʹer·ite,

10718.label: 1 Chronicles 11:45
10718.text: Je·diʹa·el the son of Shimʹri, and Joʹha his brother the Tiʹzite,

10719.label: 1 Chronicles 11:46
10719.text: Eʹli·el the Maʹha·vite, and Jerʹi·bai and Josh·a·viʹah the sons of Elʹna·am, and Ithʹmah the Moʹab·ite.

10720.label: 1 Chronicles 11:47
10720.text: Eʹli·el and Oʹbed and Ja·a·siʹel the Me·zoʹba·ite.

10721.label: 1 Chronicles 12:1
10721.text: And these are the ones that came to David at Zikʹlag while he was still under restrictions because of Saul the son of Kish; and they were among the mighty men, the helpers in the warfare,

10722.label: 1 Chronicles 12:2
10722.text: armed with the bow, using the right hand and using the left hand with stones or with arrows in the bow. They were of the brothers of Saul, of Benjamin.

10723.label: 1 Chronicles 12:3
10723.text: There was the head A·hi·eʹzer and Joʹash the sons of She·maʹah the Gibʹe·ath·ite, and Jeʹzi·el and Pelʹet the sons of Azʹma·veth, and Berʹa·cah and Jeʹhu the Anʹa·thoth·ite,

10724.label: 1 Chronicles 12:4
10724.text: and Ish·maʹiah the Gibʹe·on·ite, a mighty man among the thirty and over the thirty; and Jeremiah and Ja·ha·ziʹel and Jo·haʹnan and Joʹza·bad the Ge·deʹrath·ite,

10725.label: 1 Chronicles 12:5
10725.text: E·luʹzai and Jerʹi·moth and Be·a·liʹah and Shem·a·riʹah and Sheph·a·tiʹah the Harʹi·phite,

10726.label: 1 Chronicles 12:6
10726.text: El·kaʹnah and Is·shiʹah and Azʹar·el and Jo·eʹzer and Ja·shoʹbe·am, the Koʹrah·ites,

10727.label: 1 Chronicles 12:7
10727.text: and Jo·eʹlah and Zeb·a·diʹah the sons of Je·roʹham of Geʹdor.

10728.label: 1 Chronicles 12:8
10728.text: And there were some of the Gadʹites that separated themselves to David’s side at the place difficult to approach in the wilderness, valiant, mighty men, army men for the war, keeping the large shield and the lance ready, whose faces were the faces of lions, and they were like the gazelles upon the mountains for speed.

10729.label: 1 Chronicles 12:9
10729.text: Eʹzer was the head, O·ba·diʹah the second, E·liʹab the third,

10730.label: 1 Chronicles 12:10
10730.text: Mish·manʹnah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

10731.label: 1 Chronicles 12:11
10731.text: Atʹtai the sixth, Eʹli·el the seventh,

10732.label: 1 Chronicles 12:12
10732.text: Jo·haʹnan the eighth, El·zaʹbad the ninth,

10733.label: 1 Chronicles 12:13
10733.text: Jeremiah the tenth, Machʹban·nai the eleventh.

10734.label: 1 Chronicles 12:14
10734.text: These were of the sons of Gad, heads of the army. The least one was equal to a hundred, and the greatest to a thousand.

10735.label: 1 Chronicles 12:15
10735.text: These are the ones that crossed the Jordan in the first month when it was overflowing all its banks, and they then chased away all those of the low plains, to the east and to the west.

10736.label: 1 Chronicles 12:16
10736.text: And some of the sons of Benjamin and Judah proceeded to come clear to the place difficult to approach, to David.

10737.label: 1 Chronicles 12:17
10737.text: Then David went out before them and answered and said to them: “If it is for peace that YOU have come to me to help me, my own heart will become at unity with YOU. But if it is to betray me to my adversaries when there is no wrong on my palms, let the God of our forefathers see to it and set it in order.”

10738.label: 1 Chronicles 12:18
10738.text: And spirit itself enveloped A·maʹsai, the head of the thirty: “Yours [we are], O David, and with you [we are], O son of Jesʹse.Peace, peace be yours, and peace to the one helping you,For your God has helped you.” So David received them and put them among the heads of the troops.

10739.label: 1 Chronicles 12:19
10739.text: And there were some of Ma·nasʹseh that deserted to David when he came with the Phi·lisʹtines against Saul for battle; but he did not help them, for on counsel the axis lords of the Phi·lisʹtines sent him away, saying: “At the risk of our own heads he will desert to his lord Saul.”

10740.label: 1 Chronicles 12:20
10740.text: When he came to Zikʹlag there deserted to him from Ma·nasʹseh Adʹnah and Joʹza·bad and Je·diʹa·el and Miʹcha·el and Joʹza·bad and E·liʹhu and Zilʹle·thai, heads of the thousands that belonged to Ma·nasʹseh.

10741.label: 1 Chronicles 12:21
10741.text: And they, for their part, were of help to David against the marauder band, because all of them were mighty men of valor, and they came to be chiefs in the army;

10742.label: 1 Chronicles 12:22
10742.text: for day by day people kept coming to David to help him, until it was a great camp, like the camp of God.

10743.label: 1 Chronicles 12:23
10743.text: And these were the numbers of the heads of those equipped for the army that came to David at Heʹbron to turn the kingship of Saul over to him according to Jehovah’s order.

10744.label: 1 Chronicles 12:24
10744.text: The sons of Judah carrying the large shield and the lance were six thousand eight hundred, equipped for the army.

10745.label: 1 Chronicles 12:25
10745.text: Of the sons of Simʹe·on the mighty men of valor of the army were seven thousand one hundred.

10746.label: 1 Chronicles 12:26
10746.text: Of the sons of the Levites four thousand six hundred.

10747.label: 1 Chronicles 12:27
10747.text: And Je·hoiʹa·da was the leader [of the sons] of Aaron, and with him there were three thousand seven hundred.

10748.label: 1 Chronicles 12:28
10748.text: Also Zaʹdok a young man, mighty in valor, and the house of his forefathers, twenty-two chiefs.

10749.label: 1 Chronicles 12:29
10749.text: And of the sons of Benjamin, the brothers of Saul, there were three thousand, and up till then the greater number of them were keeping strict watch of the house of Saul.

10750.label: 1 Chronicles 12:30
10750.text: And of the sons of Eʹphra·im there were twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty men of valor, men of fame, by the house of their forefathers.

10751.label: 1 Chronicles 12:31
10751.text: And of the half tribe of Ma·nasʹseh there were eighteen thousand that had been designated by name to come to make David king.

10752.label: 1 Chronicles 12:32
10752.text: And of the sons of Isʹsa·char having a knowledge of how to discern the times to know what Israel ought to do, there were two hundred head ones of theirs, and all their brothers were at their orders.

10753.label: 1 Chronicles 12:33
10753.text: Of Zebʹu·lun those going out to the army, drawing up in battle formation with all the weapons of war, there were fifty thousand, and for flocking together [to David] they were not of a double heart.

10754.label: 1 Chronicles 12:34
10754.text: And of Naphʹta·li there were a thousand chiefs, and with them with the large shield and the spear there were thirty-seven thousand.

10755.label: 1 Chronicles 12:35
10755.text: And of the Danʹites those drawing up in battle formation were twenty-eight thousand six hundred.

10756.label: 1 Chronicles 12:36
