10756.text: And of Ashʹer those going out to the army for drawing up in battle formation were forty thousand.

10757.label: 1 Chronicles 12:37
10757.text: And from across the Jordan of the Reuʹben·ites and the Gadʹites and the half tribe of Ma·nasʹseh with all the weapons of the military army there were a hundred and twenty thousand.

10758.label: 1 Chronicles 12:38
10758.text: All these were men of war, flocking together in battle line; with a complete heart they came to Heʹbron to make David king over all Israel; and also all the remainder of Israel were of one heart for making David king.

10759.label: 1 Chronicles 12:39
10759.text: And they continued there with David three days, eating and drinking, for their brothers had made preparation for them.

10760.label: 1 Chronicles 12:40
10760.text: And also those near to them, as far as Isʹsa·char and Zebʹu·lun and Naphʹta·li, were bringing food upon asses and upon camels and upon mules and upon cattle, eatables of flour, cakes of pressed figs and cakes of raisins and wine and oil and cattle and sheep in great quantity, for there was rejoicing in Israel.

10761.label: 1 Chronicles 13:1
10761.text: And David proceeded to consult with the chiefs of the thousands and of the hundreds and with every leader;

10762.label: 1 Chronicles 13:2
10762.text: and David went on to say to all the congregation of Israel: “If it seems good to YOU and it is acceptable with Jehovah our God, let us send to our brothers that are left over in all the lands of Israel and with them [to] the priests and the Levites in their cities with pasture grounds, that they may collect themselves together to us.

10763.label: 1 Chronicles 13:3
10763.text: And let us bring the ark of our God around to ourselves.” For they had not cared for it in the days of Saul.

10764.label: 1 Chronicles 13:4
10764.text: So all the congregation said to do that way, for the thing seemed right in the eyes of all the people.

10765.label: 1 Chronicles 13:5
10765.text: Accordingly David congregated all Israel from the river of Egypt as far as the entering of Haʹmath, to bring the ark of the [true] God from Kirʹi·ath-jeʹa·rim.

10766.label: 1 Chronicles 13:6
10766.text: And David and all Israel proceeded to go up to Baʹal·ah, to Kirʹi·ath-jeʹa·rim, which belongs to Judah, to bring up from there the ark of the [true] God, Jehovah, sitting on the cherubs, where [his] name is called on.

10767.label: 1 Chronicles 13:7
10767.text: However, they had the ark of the [true] God ride upon a new wagon from the house of A·binʹa·dab, and Uzʹzah and A·hiʹo were leading the wagon.

10768.label: 1 Chronicles 13:8
10768.text: And David and all Israel were celebrating before the [true] God with full power and with songs and with harps and with stringed instruments and with tambourines and with cymbals and with trumpets.

10769.label: 1 Chronicles 13:9
10769.text: And they came gradually as far as the threshing floor of Chiʹdon, and Uzʹzah now thrust his hand out to grab hold of the Ark, for the bulls nearly caused an upset.

10770.label: 1 Chronicles 13:10
10770.text: At that Jehovah’s anger blazed against Uzʹzah, so that he struck him down because he had thrust his hand out upon the Ark, and he died there before God.

10771.label: 1 Chronicles 13:11
10771.text: And David became angry because Jehovah had broken through in a rupture against Uzʹzah; and that place came to be called Peʹrez-uzʹzah down to this day.

10772.label: 1 Chronicles 13:12
10772.text: And David became afraid of the [true] God on that day, saying: “How shall I bring the ark of the [true] God to me?”

10773.label: 1 Chronicles 13:13
10773.text: And David did not remove the Ark to himself at the City of David, but he carried it aside to the house of Oʹbed-eʹdom the Gitʹtite.

10774.label: 1 Chronicles 13:14
10774.text: And the ark of the [true] God kept dwelling with the household of Oʹbed-eʹdom, at his house three months; and Jehovah kept blessing the household of Oʹbed-eʹdom and all that was his.

10775.label: 1 Chronicles 14:1
10775.text: And Hiʹram the king of Tyre proceeded to send messengers to David and cedar timbers and builders of walls and workers in wood to build him a house.

10776.label: 1 Chronicles 14:2
10776.text: And David came to know that Jehovah had firmly established him as king over Israel, for his kingship was highly exalted on account of his people Israel.

10777.label: 1 Chronicles 14:3
10777.text: And David went on to take more wives in Jerusalem, and David came to be father to more sons and daughters.

10778.label: 1 Chronicles 14:4
10778.text: And these are the names of the children that became his in Jerusalem: Sham·muʹa and Shoʹbab, Nathan and Solʹo·mon,

10779.label: 1 Chronicles 14:5
10779.text: and Ibʹhar and E·liʹshu·a and Elʹpe·let,

10780.label: 1 Chronicles 14:6
10780.text: and Noʹgah and Neʹpheg and Ja·phiʹa,

10781.label: 1 Chronicles 14:7
10781.text: and E·lishʹa·ma and Be·e·liʹa·da and E·liphʹe·let.

10782.label: 1 Chronicles 14:8
10782.text: And the Phi·lisʹtines got to hear that David had been anointed as king over all Israel. At that all the Phi·lisʹtines came up to look for David. When David heard of it, then he went out against them.

10783.label: 1 Chronicles 14:9
10783.text: And the Phi·lisʹtines, for their part, came in and kept making raids in the low plain of Rephʹa·im.

10784.label: 1 Chronicles 14:10
10784.text: And David began to inquire of God, saying: “Shall I go up against the Phi·lisʹtines, and will you certainly give them into my hand?” At this Jehovah said to him: “Go up, and I shall certainly give them into your hand.”

10785.label: 1 Chronicles 14:11
10785.text: So David went up to Baʹal-pe·raʹzim and there got to strike them down. At that David said: “The [true] God has broken through my enemies by my hand like a gap made by waters.” That is why they called the name of that place Baʹal-pe·raʹzim.

10786.label: 1 Chronicles 14:12
10786.text: Consequently they left their gods there. Then David said [the word], and so they were burned in the fire.

10787.label: 1 Chronicles 14:13
10787.text: Later the Phi·lisʹtines once again made a raid in the low plain.

10788.label: 1 Chronicles 14:14
10788.text: At that David inquired again of God, and the [true] God now said to him: “You must not go up after them. Go around from directly against them, and you must come at them in front of the baʹca bushes.

10789.label: 1 Chronicles 14:15
10789.text: And let it occur that, when you hear the sound of the marching in the tops of the baʹca bushes, then you go out into the fight, because the [true] God will have gone out before you to strike the camp of the Phi·lisʹtines down.”

10790.label: 1 Chronicles 14:16
10790.text: So David did just as the [true] God had commanded him, and they went striking down the camp of the Phi·lisʹtines from Gibʹe·on to Geʹzer.

10791.label: 1 Chronicles 14:17
10791.text: And David’s fame began to go out into all the lands, and Jehovah himself put the dread of him upon all the nations.

10792.label: 1 Chronicles 15:1
10792.text: And he continued building houses for himself in the City of David; and he went on to prepare a place for the ark of the [true] God and pitch a tent for it.

10793.label: 1 Chronicles 15:2
10793.text: It was then that David said: “No one is to carry the ark of the [true] God but the Levites, for they are the ones whom Jehovah has chosen to carry the ark of Jehovah and to minister to him to time indefinite.”

10794.label: 1 Chronicles 15:3
10794.text: Then David congregated all Israel at Jerusalem to bring the ark of Jehovah up to its place that he had prepared for it.

10795.label: 1 Chronicles 15:4
10795.text: And David proceeded to gather the sons of Aaron and the Levites;

10796.label: 1 Chronicles 15:5
10796.text: of the sons of Koʹhath, U·riʹel the chief and his brothers, a hundred and twenty;

10797.label: 1 Chronicles 15:6
10797.text: of the sons of Me·rarʹi, A·saiʹah the chief and his brothers, two hundred and twenty;

10798.label: 1 Chronicles 15:7
10798.text: of the sons of Gerʹshom, Joel the chief and his brothers, a hundred and thirty;

10799.label: 1 Chronicles 15:8
10799.text: of the sons of E·li·zaʹphan, She·maiʹah the chief and his brothers, two hundred;

10800.label: 1 Chronicles 15:9
10800.text: of the sons of Heʹbron, Eʹli·el the chief and his brothers, eighty;

10801.label: 1 Chronicles 15:10
10801.text: of the sons of Uzʹzi·el, Am·minʹa·dab the chief and his brothers, a hundred and twelve.

10802.label: 1 Chronicles 15:11
10802.text: Furthermore, David called Zaʹdok and A·biʹa·thar the priests, and the Levites U·riʹel, A·saiʹah and Joel, She·maiʹah and Eʹli·el and Am·minʹa·dab,

10803.label: 1 Chronicles 15:12
10803.text: and he went on to say to them: “YOU are the heads of the fathers of the Levites. Sanctify yourselves, YOU and YOUR brothers, and YOU must bring the ark of Jehovah the God of Israel up to the place that I have prepared for it.

10804.label: 1 Chronicles 15:13
10804.text: Because at the first time YOU did not, Jehovah our God broke through against us, for we did not search after him according to the custom.”

10805.label: 1 Chronicles 15:14
10805.text: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of Jehovah the God of Israel.

10806.label: 1 Chronicles 15:15
10806.text: Then the sons of the Levites began to carry the ark of the [true] God, just as Moses had commanded by Jehovah’s word, upon their shoulders with the rods upon them.

10807.label: 1 Chronicles 15:16
10807.text: David now said to the chiefs of the Levites to station their brothers the singers with the instruments of song, stringed instruments and harps and cymbals, playing aloud to cause a sound of rejoicing to arise.

10808.label: 1 Chronicles 15:17
10808.text: Accordingly the Levites stationed Heʹman the son of Joel and, of his brothers, Aʹsaph the son of Ber·e·chiʹah; and, of the sons of Me·rarʹi their brothers, Eʹthan the son of Kush·aʹiah;

10809.label: 1 Chronicles 15:18
10809.text: and with them their brothers of the second division, Zech·a·riʹah, Ben and Ja·aʹzi·el and She·mirʹa·moth and Je·hiʹel and Unʹni, E·liʹab and Be·naiʹah and Ma·a·seiʹah and Mat·ti·thiʹah and E·liphʹe·le·hu and Mik·neʹiah, and Oʹbed-eʹdom and Je·iʹel the gatekeepers,

10810.label: 1 Chronicles 15:19
10810.text: and the singers Heʹman, Aʹsaph and Eʹthan, with the copper cymbals to play aloud;

10811.label: 1 Chronicles 15:20
10811.text: and Zech·a·riʹah and Aʹzi·el and She·mirʹa·moth and Je·hiʹel and Unʹni and E·liʹab and Ma·a·seiʹah and Be·naiʹah with stringed instruments tuned to Alʹa·moth,

10812.label: 1 Chronicles 15:21
10812.text: and Mat·ti·thiʹah and E·liphʹe·le·hu and Mik·neʹiah and Oʹbed-eʹdom and Je·iʹel and Az·a·ziʹah with harps tuned to Shemʹi·nith, to act as directors;

10813.label: 1 Chronicles 15:22
10813.text: and Chen·a·niʹah the chief of the Levites in carrying, he giving instruction in carrying, for he was expert;

10814.label: 1 Chronicles 15:23
10814.text: and Ber·e·chiʹah and El·kaʹnah the gatekeepers for the Ark;

10815.label: 1 Chronicles 15:24
10815.text: and Sheb·a·niʹah and Joshʹa·phat and Ne·thanʹel and A·maʹsai and Zech·a·riʹah and Be·naiʹah and E·li·eʹzer the priests loudly sounding the trumpets before the ark of the [true] God, and Oʹbed-eʹdom and Je·hiʹah the gatekeepers for the Ark.

10816.label: 1 Chronicles 15:25
10816.text: And David and the older men of Israel and the chiefs of the thousands came to be the ones walking along to bring up the ark of the covenant of Jehovah from the house of Oʹbed-eʹdom with rejoicing.

10817.label: 1 Chronicles 15:26
10817.text: And it came about when the [true] God helped the Levites while carrying the ark of the covenant of Jehovah that they proceeded to sacrifice seven young bulls and seven rams.

10818.label: 1 Chronicles 15:27
10818.text: And David was dressed in a sleeveless coat of fine fabric, and also all the Levites carrying the Ark and the singers and Chen·a·niʹah the chief of the carrying by the singers; but upon David there was an ephʹod of linen.

10819.label: 1 Chronicles 15:28
10819.text: And all the Israelites were bringing up the ark of the covenant of Jehovah with joyful shouting and with the sounding of the horn and with trumpets and with cymbals, playing aloud on stringed instruments and harps.

10820.label: 1 Chronicles 15:29
10820.text: And it came about that, when the ark of the covenant of Jehovah came as far as the City of David, Miʹchal, Saul’s daughter, herself looked down through the window and got to see King David skipping about and celebrating; and she began to despise him in her heart.

10821.label: 1 Chronicles 16:1
10821.text: Thus they brought the ark of the [true] God in and placed it inside the tent that David had pitched for it; and they began to present burnt offerings and communion sacrifices before the [true] God.

10822.label: 1 Chronicles 16:2
10822.text: When David finished offering up the burnt offering and the communion sacrifices, he went on to bless the people in the name of Jehovah.

10823.label: 1 Chronicles 16:3
10823.text: Further, he apportioned to all the Israelites, man as well as woman, to each one a round loaf of bread and a date cake and a raisin cake.

10824.label: 1 Chronicles 16:4
10824.text: Then he put before the ark of Jehovah some of the Levites as ministers, both to call to remembrance and to thank and praise Jehovah the God of Israel,

10825.label: 1 Chronicles 16:5
10825.text: Aʹsaph the head, and second to him Zech·a·riʹah, [and] Je·iʹel and She·mirʹa·moth and Je·hiʹel and Mat·ti·thiʹah and E·liʹab and Be·naiʹah and Oʹbed-eʹdom and Je·iʹel, with instruments of the string type and with harps, and Aʹsaph with the cymbals playing aloud,

10826.label: 1 Chronicles 16:6
10826.text: and Be·naiʹah and Ja·ha·ziʹel the priests with the trumpets constantly before the ark of the covenant of the [true] God.

10827.label: 1 Chronicles 16:7
10827.text: It was then on that day that David made a contribution for the first time to thank Jehovah by means of Aʹsaph and his brothers:

10828.label: 1 Chronicles 16:8
10828.text: “Give thanks to Jehovah, YOU people; call upon his name, Make his deeds known among the peoples!

10829.label: 1 Chronicles 16:9
10829.text: Sing to him, make melody to him, Concern yourselves with all his wonderful acts.

10830.label: 1 Chronicles 16:10
10830.text: Make YOUR boast in his holy name, Let the heart of those seeking Jehovah rejoice.

10831.label: 1 Chronicles 16:11
10831.text: Search after Jehovah and his strength, Seek his face constantly.

10832.label: 1 Chronicles 16:12
10832.text: Remember his wonderful acts that he has performed, His miracles and the judicial decisions of his mouth,

10833.label: 1 Chronicles 16:13
10833.text: O offspring of Israel his servant, YOU sons of Jacob, his chosen ones.

10834.label: 1 Chronicles 16:14
10834.text: He is Jehovah our God; in all the earth are his judicial decisions.

10835.label: 1 Chronicles 16:15
10835.text: Remember his covenant even to time indefinite, The word that he commanded, to a thousand generations,

10836.label: 1 Chronicles 16:16
10836.text: Which [covenant] he concluded with Abraham, And his sworn statement to Isaac.

10837.label: 1 Chronicles 16:17
10837.text: And which [statement] he kept standing as a regulation even to Jacob, As an indefinitely lasting covenant even to Israel,

10838.label: 1 Chronicles 16:18
10838.text: Saying, ‘To you I shall give the land of Caʹnaan, As the allotment of YOUR inheritance.’

10839.label: 1 Chronicles 16:19
10839.text: [This was] when YOU happened to be few in number, Yes, very few, and alien residents in it.

10840.label: 1 Chronicles 16:20
10840.text: And they kept walking about from nation to nation, And from one kingdom to another people.

10841.label: 1 Chronicles 16:21
10841.text: He did not allow anyone to defraud them, But on their account he reproved kings,

10842.label: 1 Chronicles 16:22
10842.text: [Saying,] ‘Do not YOU men touch my anointed ones, And to my prophets do nothing bad.’

10843.label: 1 Chronicles 16:23
10843.text: Sing to Jehovah, all YOU of the earth! Announce from day to day the salvation he gives!

10844.label: 1 Chronicles 16:24
10844.text: Relate among the nations his glory,Among all the peoples his wonderful acts.

10845.label: 1 Chronicles 16:25
10845.text: For Jehovah is great and very much to be praised, And he is to be feared more than all [other] gods.

10846.label: 1 Chronicles 16:26
10846.text: For all the gods of the peoples are valueless gods. As for Jehovah, he made the heavens.

10847.label: 1 Chronicles 16:27
10847.text: Dignity and splendor are before him, Strength and joy are at his place.

10848.label: 1 Chronicles 16:28
10848.text: Attribute to Jehovah, O families of peoples,Attribute to Jehovah glory and strength.

10849.label: 1 Chronicles 16:29
10849.text: Attribute to Jehovah the glory of his name, Carry a gift and come in before him. Bow down to Jehovah in holy adornment.

10850.label: 1 Chronicles 16:30
10850.text: Be in severe pains on account of him, all [YOU people of] the earth!Also the productive land is firmly established:Never will it be made to totter.

10851.label: 1 Chronicles 16:31
10851.text: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be joyful, And let them say among the nations, ‘Jehovah himself has become king!’

10852.label: 1 Chronicles 16:32
10852.text: Let the sea thunder and also that which fills it, Let the field exult and all that is in it.

10853.label: 1 Chronicles 16:33
10853.text: At the same time let the trees of the forest break out joyfully on account of Jehovah, For he has come to judge the earth.

10854.label: 1 Chronicles 16:34
10854.text: Give thanks to Jehovah, YOU people, for he is good, For to time indefinite is his loving-kindness.

10855.label: 1 Chronicles 16:35
10855.text: And say, ‘Save us, O God of our salvation, And collect us together and deliver us from the nations, To give thanks to your holy name, to speak exultingly in your praise.

10856.label: 1 Chronicles 16:36
10856.text: Blessed be Jehovah the God of Israel from time indefinite to time indefinite.’” And all the people proceeded to say, “Amen!” and a praise to Jehovah.

10857.label: 1 Chronicles 16:37
10857.text: Then he left there before the ark of the covenant of Jehovah Aʹsaph and his brothers to minister before the Ark constantly, according to the requirement of each day;

10858.label: 1 Chronicles 16:38
10858.text: and Oʹbed-eʹdom and his brothers, sixty-eight, and Oʹbed-eʹdom the son of Je·duʹthun and Hoʹsah as gatekeepers;

10859.label: 1 Chronicles 16:39
10859.text: and Zaʹdok the priest and his brothers the priests before the tabernacle of Jehovah on the high place that was at Gibʹe·on,

10860.label: 1 Chronicles 16:40
10860.text: to offer up burnt offerings to Jehovah on the altar of burnt offering constantly morning and evening and for all that is written in the law of Jehovah that he laid in command upon Israel;

10861.label: 1 Chronicles 16:41
10861.text: and with them Heʹman and Je·duʹthun and the rest of the select men that were designated by names to thank Jehovah, because “to time indefinite is his loving-kindness”;

10862.label: 1 Chronicles 16:42
10862.text: and with them Heʹman and Je·duʹthun, to sound forth the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of the song of the [true] God; and the sons of Je·duʹthun at the gate.

10863.label: 1 Chronicles 16:43
10863.text: And all the people proceeded to go each one to his own house. Accordingly David went around to bless his own house.

10864.label: 1 Chronicles 17:1
10864.text: And it came about that as soon as David had begun dwelling in his own house, David proceeded to say to Nathan the prophet: “Here I am dwelling in a house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of Jehovah is under tent cloths.”

10865.label: 1 Chronicles 17:2
10865.text: Upon that Nathan said to David: “Everything that is in your heart do, for the [true] God is with you.”

10866.label: 1 Chronicles 17:3
10866.text: And it came about on that night that the word of God came to Nathan, saying:

10867.label: 1 Chronicles 17:4
10867.text: “Go, and you must say to David my servant, ‘This is what Jehovah has said: “It will not be you that will build me the house in which to dwell.

10868.label: 1 Chronicles 17:5
10868.text: For I have not dwelt in a house from the day that I brought Israel up until this day, but I continued from tent to tent and from one tabernacle [to another].

10869.label: 1 Chronicles 17:6
10869.text: During all the time that I walked about in all Israel, did I speak a single word with one of the judges of Israel whom I commanded to shepherd my people, saying, ‘Why have YOU men not built me a house of cedars?’”’

10870.label: 1 Chronicles 17:7
10870.text: “And now this is what you will say to my servant David, ‘This is what Jehovah of armies has said: “I myself took you from the pasture ground from following the flock to become a leader over my people Israel.

10871.label: 1 Chronicles 17:8
10871.text: And I shall prove to be with you wherever you do walk, and I shall cut off all your enemies from before you, and I shall certainly make for you a name like the name of the great ones that are upon the earth.

10872.label: 1 Chronicles 17:9
10872.text: And I shall certainly appoint a place for my people Israel and plant them, and they will indeed reside where they are and no more will they be disturbed; and the sons of unrighteousness will not wear them out again, just as they did at the first,

10873.label: 1 Chronicles 17:10
10873.text: even since the days that I put judges in command over my people Israel. And I shall certainly humble all your enemies. And I tell you, ‘Also a house Jehovah will build for you.’

10874.label: 1 Chronicles 17:11
10874.text: “‘“And it must occur that when your days have come to the full [for you] to go [to be] with your forefathers, I shall certainly raise up your seed after you that will come to be one of your sons, and I shall indeed firmly establish his kingship.

10875.label: 1 Chronicles 17:12
10875.text: He is the one that will build me a house, and I shall certainly establish his throne firmly to time indefinite.

10876.label: 1 Chronicles 17:13
10876.text: I myself shall become his father, and he himself will become my son; and my loving-kindness I shall not remove from him the way I removed it from the one that happened to be prior to you.

10877.label: 1 Chronicles 17:14
10877.text: And I will cause him to stand in my house and in my kingship to time indefinite, and his throne will itself become one lasting to time indefinite.”’”

10878.label: 1 Chronicles 17:15
10878.text: According to all these words and according to all this vision was the way that Nathan spoke to David.

10879.label: 1 Chronicles 17:16
10879.text: After that King David came in and sat down before Jehovah and said: “Who am I, O Jehovah God, and what is my house that you have brought me thus far?

10880.label: 1 Chronicles 17:17
10880.text: As though this should be something little in your eyes, O God, yet you speak concerning the house of your servant down to a distant future time, and you have looked on me according to the opportunity of the man in the ascendancy, O Jehovah God.

10881.label: 1 Chronicles 17:18
10881.text: What more could David say to you as to honoring your servant, when you yourself know your servant well?

10882.label: 1 Chronicles 17:19
10882.text: O Jehovah, for the sake of your servant and in agreement with your own heart you have done all these great things by making all the great achievements known.

10883.label: 1 Chronicles 17:20
10883.text: O Jehovah, there is none like you, and there is no God except you in connection with all that we have heard with our ears.

10884.label: 1 Chronicles 17:21
10884.text: And what other nation in the earth is like your people Israel, whom the [true] God went to redeem to himself as a people, to assign to yourself a name of great achievements and fear-inspiring things by driving out nations from before your people whom you have redeemed from Egypt?

10885.label: 1 Chronicles 17:22
10885.text: And you proceeded to constitute your people Israel as your people to time indefinite, and you yourself, O Jehovah, became their God.

10886.label: 1 Chronicles 17:23
10886.text: And now, O Jehovah, let the word that you have spoken concerning your servant and concerning his house prove faithful to time indefinite, and do just as you have spoken.

10887.label: 1 Chronicles 17:24
10887.text: And let your name prove faithful and become great to time indefinite, saying, ‘Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, is God to Israel,’ and let the house of David your servant be one lasting before you.

10888.label: 1 Chronicles 17:25
10888.text: For you yourself, my God, have revealed to your servant the purpose to build him a house. That is why your servant has found occasion to pray before you.

10889.label: 1 Chronicles 17:26
10889.text: And now, O Jehovah, you are the [true] God, and you promise this goodness concerning your servant.

10890.label: 1 Chronicles 17:27
10890.text: And now you must take it upon yourself and bless the house of your servant [for it] to continue to time indefinite before you; for you yourself, O Jehovah, have blessed, and it is blessed to time indefinite.”

10891.label: 1 Chronicles 18:1
10891.text: And it came about afterward that David proceeded to strike down the Phi·lisʹtines and subdue them and take Gath and its dependent towns out of the hand of the Phi·lisʹtines.

10892.label: 1 Chronicles 18:2
10892.text: Then he struck Moʹab down, and the Moʹab·ites came to be David’s servants bearing tribute.

10893.label: 1 Chronicles 18:3
10893.text: And David went on to strike down Had·ad·eʹzer the king of Zoʹbah at Haʹmath as he was going his way to set up his control at the river Eu·phraʹtes.

10894.label: 1 Chronicles 18:4
10894.text: Further, David captured from him a thousand chariots and seven thousand horsemen and twenty thousand men on foot. Then David hamstrung all the chariot horses, but he let a hundred chariot horses of them remain.

10895.label: 1 Chronicles 18:5
10895.text: When Syria of Damascus came to help Had·ad·eʹzer the king of Zoʹbah, David went striking down among the Syrians twenty-two thousand men.

10896.label: 1 Chronicles 18:6
10896.text: After that David put [garrisons] in Syria of Damascus, and the Syrians came to be David’s servants bearing tribute. And Jehovah kept giving salvation to David wherever he went.

10897.label: 1 Chronicles 18:7
10897.text: Moreover, David took the circular shields of gold that happened to be on the servants of Had·ad·eʹzer and brought them to Jerusalem.

10898.label: 1 Chronicles 18:8
10898.text: And from Tibʹhath and Cun, cities of Had·ad·eʹzer, David took very much copper. With it Solʹo·mon made the copper sea and the pillars and the copper utensils.

10899.label: 1 Chronicles 18:9
10899.text: When Toʹu the king of Haʹmath heard that David had struck down all the military force of Had·ad·eʹzer the king of Zoʹbah,

10900.label: 1 Chronicles 18:10
10900.text: he immediately sent Ha·doʹram his son to King David to ask him about his welfare and congratulate him over the fact that he had fought against Had·ad·eʹzer so that he struck him down, (for Had·ad·eʹzer had become trained in warfare against Toʹu, ) and [there were with him] all sorts of articles of gold and silver and copper.

10901.label: 1 Chronicles 18:11
10901.text: These also King David sanctified to Jehovah together with the silver and the gold that he had carried off from all the nations, from Eʹdom and from Moʹab and from the sons of Amʹmon and from the Phi·lisʹtines and from Amʹa·lek.

10902.label: 1 Chronicles 18:12
10902.text: As for A·bishʹai the son of Ze·ruʹiah, he struck down the Eʹdom·ites in the Valley of Salt, eighteen thousand.

10903.label: 1 Chronicles 18:13
10903.text: So he put garrisons in Eʹdom, and all the Eʹdom·ites came to be David’s servants. And Jehovah kept saving David wherever he went.

10904.label: 1 Chronicles 18:14
10904.text: And David continued to reign over all Israel, and he was continually rendering judicial decision and righteousness for all his people.

10905.label: 1 Chronicles 18:15
10905.text: And Joʹab the son of Ze·ruʹiah was over the army, and Je·hoshʹa·phat the son of A·hiʹlud was recorder.

10906.label: 1 Chronicles 18:16
10906.text: And Zaʹdok the son of A·hiʹtub and A·himʹe·lech the son of A·biʹa·thar were priests, and Shavʹsha was secretary.

10907.label: 1 Chronicles 18:17
10907.text: And Be·naiʹah the son of Je·hoiʹa·da was over the Cherʹe·thites and the Pelʹe·thites; and the sons of David were the first in position at the side of the king.

10908.label: 1 Chronicles 19:1
10908.text: And it came about afterward that Naʹhash the king of the sons of Amʹmon came to die, and his son began to reign in place of him.

10909.label: 1 Chronicles 19:2
10909.text: At that David said: “I shall exercise loving-kindness toward Haʹnun the son of Naʹhash, because his father exercised loving-kindness toward me.” Accordingly David sent messengers to comfort him over his father, and the servants of David proceeded to come into the land of the sons of Amʹmon to Haʹnun to comfort him.

10910.label: 1 Chronicles 19:3
10910.text: However, the princes of the sons of Amʹmon said to Haʹnun: “Is David honoring your father in your eyes in that he has sent comforters to you? Is it not for the sake of making a thorough search and causing an overthrow and for spying out the land that his servants have come in to you?”

10911.label: 1 Chronicles 19:4
10911.text: So Haʹnun took the servants of David and shaved them and cut their garments in half to their buttocks and sent them away.

10912.label: 1 Chronicles 19:5
10912.text: Later people went and told David about the men; and he at once sent to meet them, because they had become men very much humiliated; and the king went on to say: “Dwell in Jerʹi·cho until YOUR beards grow abundantly. Then YOU must return.”

10913.label: 1 Chronicles 19:6
10913.text: In time the sons of Amʹmon saw that they had become foul-smelling to David, and Haʹnun and the sons of Amʹmon proceeded to send a thousand silver talents to hire for themselves chariots and horsemen from Mes·o·po·taʹmi·a and from Aʹram-maʹa·cah and from Zoʹbah.

10914.label: 1 Chronicles 19:7
10914.text: Thus they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots and the king of Maʹa·cah and his people. Then they came in and camped before Medʹe·ba; and as for the sons of Amʹmon, they gathered together from their cities and now came in for the war.

10915.label: 1 Chronicles 19:8
10915.text: When David heard of it, he immediately sent Joʹab and all the army [and] the mighty men.

10916.label: 1 Chronicles 19:9
10916.text: And the sons of Amʹmon began to go out and draw up in battle formation at the entrance of the city, and the kings that had come were by themselves in the open field.

10917.label: 1 Chronicles 19:10
10917.text: When Joʹab saw that the battle charges had come to be against him from the front and from the rear, he at once chose some of all the choice men in Israel and drew them up in formation to meet the Syrians.

10918.label: 1 Chronicles 19:11
10918.text: And the rest of the people he gave into the hand of A·bishʹai his brother, that they might draw up in formation to meet the sons of Amʹmon.

10919.label: 1 Chronicles 19:12
10919.text: And he went on to say: “If the Syrians become too strong for me, you must also serve as a salvation for me; but if the sons of Amʹmon themselves become too strong for you, I must also save you.

10920.label: 1 Chronicles 19:13
10920.text: Be strong, that we may show ourselves courageous in behalf of our people and in behalf of the cities of our God; and as for Jehovah, what is good in his own eyes he will do.”

10921.label: 1 Chronicles 19:14
10921.text: Then Joʹab and the people that were with him advanced before the Syrians to the battle, and they took to flight from before him.

10922.label: 1 Chronicles 19:15
10922.text: As for the sons of Amʹmon, they saw that the Syrians had fled, and they themselves also took to flight from before A·bishʹai his brother and then came into the city. Later Joʹab came into Jerusalem.

10923.label: 1 Chronicles 19:16
10923.text: When the Syrians saw that they had been defeated before Israel, they proceeded to send messengers and bring out the Syrians that were in the region of the River, with Shoʹphach the chief of the army of Had·ad·eʹzer before them.

10924.label: 1 Chronicles 19:17
10924.text: When the report was made to David, he immediately gathered all Israel together and crossed the Jordan and came to them and drew up in formation against them. When David drew up in battle formation to meet the Syrians, they began to fight against him.

10925.label: 1 Chronicles 19:18
10925.text: But the Syrians took to flight because of Israel; and David went killing of the Syrians seven thousand charioteers and forty thousand men on foot, and Shoʹphach the chief of the army himself he put to death.

10926.label: 1 Chronicles 19:19
10926.text: When the servants of Had·ad·eʹzer saw that they had been defeated before Israel, they promptly made peace with David and began to serve him; and Syria did not want to try saving the sons of Amʹmon anymore.

10927.label: 1 Chronicles 20:1
10927.text: And it came about at the time of the year’s return, at the time that kings sally forth, that Joʹab proceeded to lead the combat force of the army and lay the land of the sons of Amʹmon in ruin and to come and besiege Rabʹbah, while David was dwelling in Jerusalem; and Joʹab went on to strike Rabʹbah and throw it down.

10928.label: 1 Chronicles 20:2
10928.text: But David took the crown of Malʹcam off its head, and found it to be a talent of gold in weight, and in it there were precious stones; and it came to be on David’s head. And the spoil of the city that he brought out was very much.

10929.label: 1 Chronicles 20:3
10929.text: And the people that were in it he brought out, and he kept them employed at sawing stones and at sharp instruments of iron and at axes; and that was the way David proceeded to do to all the cities of the sons of Amʹmon. Finally David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

10930.label: 1 Chronicles 20:4
10930.text: And it came about after this that war began breaking out at Geʹzer with the Phi·lisʹtines. It was then that Sibʹbe·cai the Huʹshath·ite struck down Sipʹpai of those born of the Rephʹa·im, so that they were subdued.

10931.label: 1 Chronicles 20:5
10931.text: And there came to be war again with the Phi·lisʹtines; and El·haʹnan the son of Jaʹir got to strike down Lahʹmi the brother of Go·liʹath the Gitʹtite, the shaft of whose spear was like the beam of loom workers.

10932.label: 1 Chronicles 20:6
10932.text: And there came to be war again at Gath, when there happened to be a man of extraordinary size whose fingers and toes were in sixes, twenty-four; and he, too, had been born to the Rephʹa·im.

10933.label: 1 Chronicles 20:7
10933.text: And he kept taunting Israel. Finally Jonʹa·than the son of Shimʹe·a the brother of David struck him down.

10934.label: 1 Chronicles 20:8
10934.text: These were the ones that had been born to the Rephʹa·im in Gath; and they came to fall by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.

10935.label: 1 Chronicles 21:1
10935.text: And Satan proceeded to stand up against Israel and to incite David to number Israel.

10936.label: 1 Chronicles 21:2
10936.text: So David said to Joʹab and the chiefs of the people: “Go, count Israel from Beʹer-sheʹba to Dan and bring it to me that I may know their number.”

10937.label: 1 Chronicles 21:3
10937.text: But Joʹab said: “May Jehovah add to his people a hundred times as many as they are. Do they not, O my lord the king, all of them belong to my lord as servants? Why does my lord seek this? Why should he become a cause of guilt to Israel?”

10938.label: 1 Chronicles 21:4
10938.text: The king’s word, however, prevailed over Joʹab, so that Joʹab went out and walked through all Israel, after which he came to Jerusalem.

10939.label: 1 Chronicles 21:5
10939.text: Joʹab now gave the number of the registration of the people to David; and all Israel amounted to a million one hundred thousand men drawing sword, and Judah four hundred and seventy thousand men drawing sword.

10940.label: 1 Chronicles 21:6
10940.text: And Leʹvi and Benjamin he did not register in among them, because the king’s word had been detestable to Joʹab.

10941.label: 1 Chronicles 21:7
10941.text: Now this thing was bad in the eyes of the [true] God, and so he struck down Israel.

10942.label: 1 Chronicles 21:8
10942.text: Consequently David said to the [true] God: “I have sinned very much in that I have done this thing. And now, please, cause your servant’s error to pass away; for I have acted very foolishly.”

10943.label: 1 Chronicles 21:9
10943.text: And Jehovah proceeded to speak to Gad, David’s visionary, saying:

10944.label: 1 Chronicles 21:10
10944.text: “Go, and you must speak to David, saying, ‘This is what Jehovah has said: “There are three things that I am directing against you. Choose for yourself one of them, that I may do it to you.”’”

10945.label: 1 Chronicles 21:11
10945.text: Accordingly Gad went in to David and said to him: “This is what Jehovah has said, ‘Take your pick,

10946.label: 1 Chronicles 21:12
10946.text: whether for three years there is to be a famine; or for three months there is to be a sweeping away from before your adversaries and for the sword of your enemies to overtake [you], or for three days there is to be the sword of Jehovah, even pestilence, in the land, with Jehovah’s angel bringing ruin in all the territory of Israel.’ And now see what I should reply to the One sending me.”

10947.label: 1 Chronicles 21:13
10947.text: So David said to Gad: “It is very distressing to me. Please, let me fall into the hand of Jehovah, for very many are his mercies; but into the hand of man do not let me fall.”

10948.label: 1 Chronicles 21:14
10948.text: Then Jehovah gave a pestilence in Israel, so that out of Israel seventy thousand persons fell.

10949.label: 1 Chronicles 21:15
10949.text: Moreover, the [true] God sent an angel to Jerusalem to bring ruin to it; and as soon as he began bringing the ruin, Jehovah saw it and began to feel regret over the calamity; and so he said to the angel that was bringing the ruin: “It is enough! Now let your hand drop.” And Jehovah’s angel was standing close by the threshing floor of Orʹnan the Jebʹu·site.

10950.label: 1 Chronicles 21:16
10950.text: When David raised his eyes, he got to see Jehovah’s angel standing between the earth and the heavens with his drawn sword in his hand extended toward Jerusalem; and David and the older men, covered with sackcloth, at once fell down upon their faces.

10951.label: 1 Chronicles 21:17
10951.text: And David proceeded to say to the [true] God: “Was it not I that said to make a numbering of the people, and is it not I that have sinned and have unquestionably done bad? As for these sheep, what have they done? O Jehovah my God, let your hand, please, come to be upon me and my father’s house; but not upon your people, for a scourge.”

10952.label: 1 Chronicles 21:18
10952.text: And Jehovah’s angel, for his part, said to Gad to say to David that David should go up to erect an altar to Jehovah on the threshing floor of Orʹnan the Jebʹu·site.

10953.label: 1 Chronicles 21:19
10953.text: Accordingly David went up at the word of Gad that he had spoken in the name of Jehovah.

10954.label: 1 Chronicles 21:20
10954.text: Meantime, Orʹnan turned back and saw the angel; and his four sons with him were hiding themselves. Now Orʹnan had been threshing wheat.

10955.label: 1 Chronicles 21:21
10955.text: So David came as far as Orʹnan. When Orʹnan looked and saw David, he immediately went out of the threshing floor and bowed down to David with his face to the earth.

10956.label: 1 Chronicles 21:22
10956.text: Then David said to Orʹnan: “Do give me the place of the threshing floor, that I may build in it an altar to Jehovah. For the money in full give it to me, that the scourge may be halted from upon the people.”

10957.label: 1 Chronicles 21:23
10957.text: But Orʹnan said to David: “Take it as your own, and let my lord the king do what is good in his own eyes. See, I do give the cattle for burnt offerings and the threshing sledge for the wood and the wheat as a grain offering. The whole I do give.”

10958.label: 1 Chronicles 21:24
10958.text: However, King David said to Orʹnan: “No, but without fail I shall make the purchase for the money in full, because I shall not carry what is yours to Jehovah to offer up burnt sacrifices without cost.”

10959.label: 1 Chronicles 21:25
10959.text: So David gave Orʹnan for the place gold shekels to the weight of six hundred.

10960.label: 1 Chronicles 21:26
10960.text: Then David built there an altar to Jehovah and offered up burnt sacrifices and communion sacrifices, and he proceeded to call upon Jehovah, who now answered him with fire from the heavens upon the altar of burnt offering.

10961.label: 1 Chronicles 21:27
10961.text: Moreover, Jehovah said the word to the angel, who accordingly returned his sword to its sheath.

10962.label: 1 Chronicles 21:28
10962.text: At that time, when David saw that Jehovah had answered him at the threshing floor of Orʹnan the Jebʹu·site, he continued to sacrifice there.

10963.label: 1 Chronicles 21:29
10963.text: But the tabernacle of Jehovah that Moses had made in the wilderness and the altar of burnt offering were at that time on the high place at Gibʹe·on.

10964.label: 1 Chronicles 21:30
10964.text: And David had not been able to go before it to consult God, for he had been terrified because of the sword of Jehovah’s angel.

10965.label: 1 Chronicles 22:1
10965.text: Then David said: “This is the house of Jehovah the [true] God, and this is an altar for burnt offering for Israel.”

10966.label: 1 Chronicles 22:2
10966.text: David now said to bring together the alien residents that were in the land of Israel, and then he set them as stone hewers to hew squared stones for building the house of the [true] God.

10967.label: 1 Chronicles 22:3
10967.text: And iron in great quantity for nails for the doors of the gates and for clamps David prepared, and also copper in such quantity as to be beyond weighing,

10968.label: 1 Chronicles 22:4
10968.text: and also cedar timbers without number; for the Si·doʹni·ans and the Tyrʹi·ans brought in cedar timbers in great quantity to David.

10969.label: 1 Chronicles 22:5
10969.text: Accordingly David said: “Solʹo·mon my son is young and delicate, and the house to be built to Jehovah is to be surpassingly magnificent for beauteous distinction to all the lands. Let me, then, make preparation for him.” So David made preparation in great quantities before his death.

10970.label: 1 Chronicles 22:6
10970.text: Moreover, he called Solʹo·mon his son that he might command him to build a house to Jehovah the God of Israel.

10971.label: 1 Chronicles 22:7
10971.text: And David went on to say to Solʹo·mon his son: “As for myself, it became close to my heart to build a house to the name of Jehovah my God.

10972.label: 1 Chronicles 22:8
10972.text: But Jehovah’s word came against me, saying, ‘Blood in great quantity you have spilled, and great wars you have waged. You will not build a house to my name, for a great deal of blood you have spilled on the earth before me.

10973.label: 1 Chronicles 22:9
10973.text: Look! There is a son being born to you. He himself will prove to be a restful man, and I shall certainly give him rest from all his enemies all around; for Solʹo·mon is what his name will become, and peace and quietness I shall bestow upon Israel in his days.

10974.label: 1 Chronicles 22:10
10974.text: It is he that will build a house to my name, and he himself will become a son to me, and I a father to him. And I shall certainly establish the throne of his kingship firmly over Israel to time indefinite.’

10975.label: 1 Chronicles 22:11
10975.text: “Now, my son, may Jehovah prove to be with you, and you must prove successful and build the house of Jehovah your God, just as he has spoken concerning you.

10976.label: 1 Chronicles 22:12
10976.text: Only may Jehovah give you discretion and understanding, and may he give you commandment concerning Israel even to keep the law of Jehovah your God.

10977.label: 1 Chronicles 22:13
10977.text: In that case you will prove successful if you take care to carry out the regulations and the judicial decisions that Jehovah commanded Moses respecting Israel. Be courageous and strong. Do not be afraid nor be terrified.

10978.label: 1 Chronicles 22:14
10978.text: And here during my affliction I have prepared for Jehovah’s house a hundred thousand talents of gold and a million talents of silver, and the copper and the iron there is no means of weighing because they have come to be in such quantity; and timbers and stones I have prepared, but to them you will make additions.

10979.label: 1 Chronicles 22:15
10979.text: And with you there are in great number doers of work, stone hewers and workers in stone and wood and every one skillful in every sort of work.

10980.label: 1 Chronicles 22:16
10980.text: The gold, the silver and the copper and the iron there is no means of numbering. Rise and act, and may Jehovah prove to be with you.”

10981.label: 1 Chronicles 22:17
10981.text: And David went on to command all the princes of Israel to help Solʹo·mon his son:

10982.label: 1 Chronicles 22:18
10982.text: “Is not Jehovah YOUR God with YOU, and has he not given YOU rest all around? For he has given into my hand the inhabitants of the land, and the land has been subdued before Jehovah and before his people.

10983.label: 1 Chronicles 22:19
10983.text: Now set YOUR heart and YOUR soul to inquire after Jehovah YOUR God, and rise and build the sanctuary of Jehovah the [true] God, to bring the ark of the covenant of Jehovah and the holy utensils of the [true] God to the house built to the name of Jehovah.”

10984.label: 1 Chronicles 23:1
10984.text: And David himself had grown old and satisfied with days, and so he made Solʹo·mon his son king over Israel.

10985.label: 1 Chronicles 23:2
10985.text: And he proceeded to gather all the princes of Israel and the priests and the Levites.

10986.label: 1 Chronicles 23:3
10986.text: Accordingly the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years upward; and their number, head by head of them, able-bodied man by able-bodied man, came to be thirty-eight thousand.

10987.label: 1 Chronicles 23:4
10987.text: Of these for acting as supervisors over the work of the house of Jehovah there were twenty-four thousand; and as officers and judges six thousand;

10988.label: 1 Chronicles 23:5
10988.text: and four thousand gatekeepers and four thousand givers of praise to Jehovah on the instruments that [David said] “I have made for giving praise.”

10989.label: 1 Chronicles 23:6
10989.text: Then David distributed them in divisions to the sons of Leʹvi, to Gerʹshon, Koʹhath and Me·rarʹi.

10990.label: 1 Chronicles 23:7
10990.text: To the Gerʹshon·ites, Laʹdan and Shimʹe·i.

10991.label: 1 Chronicles 23:8
10991.text: The sons of Laʹdan were Je·hiʹel the headman and Zeʹtham and Joel, three.

10992.label: 1 Chronicles 23:9
10992.text: The sons of Shimʹe·i were She·loʹmoth and Haʹzi·el and Haʹran, three. These were the heads of the fathers for Laʹdan.

10993.label: 1 Chronicles 23:10
10993.text: And the sons of Shimʹe·i were Jaʹhath, Ziʹna and Jeʹush and Be·riʹah. These four were the sons of Shimʹe·i.

10994.label: 1 Chronicles 23:11
10994.text: And Jaʹhath came to be the head, and Ziʹzah the second. As for Jeʹush and Be·riʹah, they did not have many sons; so they became a paternal house for one official class.

10995.label: 1 Chronicles 23:12
10995.text: The sons of Koʹhath were Amʹram, Izʹhar, Heʹbron and Uzʹzi·el, four.

10996.label: 1 Chronicles 23:13
10996.text: The sons of Amʹram were Aaron and Moses. But Aaron was separated that he might sanctify the Most Holy, he and his sons to time indefinite, to make sacrificial smoke before Jehovah, to minister to him and to pronounce blessing in his name to time indefinite.

10997.label: 1 Chronicles 23:14
10997.text: As for Moses the man of the [true] God, his sons themselves continued to be called among the tribe of the Levites.

10998.label: 1 Chronicles 23:15
10998.text: The sons of Moses were Gerʹshom and E·li·eʹzer.

10999.label: 1 Chronicles 23:16
10999.text: The sons of Gerʹshom were Shebʹu·el the head.

11000.label: 1 Chronicles 23:17
11000.text: And the sons of E·li·eʹzer came to be Re·ha·biʹah the head; and E·li·eʹzer did not come to have other sons, but the sons of Re·ha·biʹah did themselves become exceedingly many.

11001.label: 1 Chronicles 23:18
11001.text: The sons of Izʹhar were She·loʹmith the headman.

11002.label: 1 Chronicles 23:19
11002.text: The sons of Heʹbron were Je·riʹah the head, Am·a·riʹah the second, Ja·ha·ziʹel the third and Jek·a·meʹam the fourth.

11003.label: 1 Chronicles 23:20
11003.text: The sons of Uzʹzi·el were Miʹcah the head and Is·shiʹah the second.

11004.label: 1 Chronicles 23:21
11004.text: The sons of Me·rarʹi were Mahʹli and Muʹshi. The sons of Mahʹli were El·e·aʹzar and Kish.

11005.label: 1 Chronicles 23:22
11005.text: But El·e·aʹzar died; and he had come to have, not sons, but daughters. So the sons of Kish their brothers took them [as wives].

11006.label: 1 Chronicles 23:23
11006.text: The sons of Muʹshi were Mahʹli and Eʹder and Jerʹe·moth, three.

11007.label: 1 Chronicles 23:24
11007.text: These were the sons of Leʹvi by the house of their fathers, the heads of the fathers, by their commissioned ones, in the number of the names, head by head of them, the doers of the work for the service of the house of Jehovah, from the age of twenty years upward.

11008.label: 1 Chronicles 23:25
11008.text: For David had said: “Jehovah the God of Israel has given rest to his people, and he will reside in Jerusalem to time indefinite.

11009.label: 1 Chronicles 23:26
11009.text: And also the Levites will not have to carry the tabernacle or any of its utensils for its service.”

11010.label: 1 Chronicles 23:27
11010.text: For by the last words of David these were the number of the sons of Leʹvi from the age of twenty years upward.

11011.label: 1 Chronicles 23:28
11011.text: For their function was at the disposition of the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of Jehovah over the courtyards and over the dining rooms and over the purification of every holy thing and the work of the service of the house of the [true] God,

11012.label: 1 Chronicles 23:29
11012.text: even for the layer bread and for the fine flour for the grain offering and for the wafers of unfermented bread and for the griddle [cakes] and for the mixed dough and for all measures of quantity and size;

11013.label: 1 Chronicles 23:30
11013.text: and for standing morning by morning to thank and praise Jehovah, and likewise at evening;

11014.label: 1 Chronicles 23:31
11014.text: and for every offering up of the burnt sacrifices to Jehovah at the sabbaths, at the new moons and at the festival seasons, by number according to the rule concerning them, constantly before Jehovah.

11015.label: 1 Chronicles 23:32
11015.text: And they took care of the guarding of the tent of meeting and the guarding of the holy place and the guarding of the sons of Aaron their brothers for the service of the house of Jehovah.

11016.label: 1 Chronicles 24:1
11016.text: Now the sons of Aaron had their divisions. The sons of Aaron were Naʹdab and A·biʹhu, El·e·aʹzar and Ithʹa·mar.

11017.label: 1 Chronicles 24:2
11017.text: However, Naʹdab and A·biʹhu died before their father, and they did not happen to have any sons, but El·e·aʹzar and Ithʹa·mar continued to act as priests.

11018.label: 1 Chronicles 24:3
11018.text: And David, and Zaʹdok from the sons of El·e·aʹzar, and A·himʹe·lech from the sons of Ithʹa·mar proceeded to make divisions of them for their office in their service.

11019.label: 1 Chronicles 24:4
11019.text: But the sons of El·e·aʹzar were found to be more numerous in headmen than the sons of Ithʹa·mar. So they distributed them to the sons of El·e·aʹzar, as heads for [their] paternal houses, sixteen, and to the sons of Ithʹa·mar, [as heads] for their paternal houses, eight.

11020.label: 1 Chronicles 24:5
11020.text: Further, they distributed them by lots, these along with those, for there had to be chiefs of the holy place and chiefs of the [true] God from the sons of El·e·aʹzar and from the sons of Ithʹa·mar.

11021.label: 1 Chronicles 24:6
11021.text: Then She·maiʹah the son of Ne·thanʹel the secretary of the Levites wrote them down before the king and the princes and Zaʹdok the priest and A·himʹe·lech the son of A·biʹa·thar and the heads of the fathers of the priests and of the Levites, one paternal house being picked out for El·e·aʹzar and one being picked out for Ithʹa·mar.

11022.label: 1 Chronicles 24:7
11022.text: And the lot proceeded to come out: the first for Je·hoiʹa·rib; for Je·daʹiah the second,

11023.label: 1 Chronicles 24:8
11023.text: for Haʹrim the third, for Se·oʹrim the fourth,

11024.label: 1 Chronicles 24:9
11024.text: for Mal·chiʹjah the fifth, for Mijʹa·min the sixth,

11025.label: 1 Chronicles 24:10
11025.text: for Hakʹkoz the seventh, for A·biʹjah the eighth,

11026.label: 1 Chronicles 24:11
11026.text: for Jeshʹu·a the ninth, for Shec·a·niʹah the tenth,

11027.label: 1 Chronicles 24:12
11027.text: for E·liʹa·shib the eleventh, for Jaʹkim the twelfth,

11028.label: 1 Chronicles 24:13
11028.text: for Hupʹpah the thirteenth, for Je·shebʹe·ab the fourteenth,

11029.label: 1 Chronicles 24:14
11029.text: for Bilʹgah the fifteenth, for Imʹmer the sixteenth,

11030.label: 1 Chronicles 24:15
11030.text: for Heʹzir the seventeenth, for Hapʹpiz·zez the eighteenth,

11031.label: 1 Chronicles 24:16
11031.text: for Peth·a·hiʹah the nineteenth, for Je·hezʹkel the twentieth,

11032.label: 1 Chronicles 24:17
11032.text: for Jaʹchin the twenty-first, for Gaʹmul the twenty-second,

11033.label: 1 Chronicles 24:18
11033.text: for De·laʹiah the twenty-third, for Ma·a·ziʹah the twenty-fourth.

11034.label: 1 Chronicles 24:19
11034.text: These were their offices for their service, to come into the house of Jehovah according to their due right by the hand of Aaron their forefather, just as Jehovah the God of Israel had commanded him.

11035.label: 1 Chronicles 24:20
11035.text: And of the sons of Leʹvi that were left over, of the sons of Amʹram there was Shuʹba·el; of the sons of Shuʹba·el, Jeh·deʹiah;

11036.label: 1 Chronicles 24:21
11036.text: of Re·ha·biʹah: of the sons of Re·ha·biʹah, Is·shiʹah the head;

11037.label: 1 Chronicles 24:22
11037.text: of the Izʹhar·ites, She·loʹmoth; of the sons of She·loʹmoth, Jaʹhath;

11038.label: 1 Chronicles 24:23
11038.text: and the sons [of Heʹbron], Je·riʹah the head, Am·a·riʹah the second, Ja·ha·ziʹel the third, Jek·a·meʹam the fourth.

11039.label: 1 Chronicles 24:24
11039.text: The sons of Uzʹzi·el, Miʹcah; of the sons of Miʹcah, Shaʹmir.

11040.label: 1 Chronicles 24:25
11040.text: The brother of Miʹcah was Is·shiʹah; of the sons of Is·shiʹah, Zech·a·riʹah.

11041.label: 1 Chronicles 24:26
11041.text: The sons of Me·rarʹi were Mahʹli and Muʹshi; the sons of Ja·a·ziʹah, Beʹno.

11042.label: 1 Chronicles 24:27
11042.text: The sons of Me·rarʹi: Of Ja·a·ziʹah, Beʹno and Shoʹham and Zacʹcur and Ibʹri.

11043.label: 1 Chronicles 24:28
11043.text: Of Mahʹli, El·e·aʹzar, who did not come to have any sons.

11044.label: 1 Chronicles 24:29
11044.text: Of Kish: the sons of Kish were Je·rahʹme·el.

11045.label: 1 Chronicles 24:30
11045.text: And the sons of Muʹshi were Mahʹli and Eʹder and Jerʹi·moth. These were the sons of the Levites by their paternal houses.

11046.label: 1 Chronicles 24:31
11046.text: And they themselves also proceeded to cast lots exactly as their brothers the sons of Aaron did before David the king and Zaʹdok and A·himʹe·lech and the heads of the paternal houses of the priests and of the Levites. As respects paternal houses, the head one was exactly as his younger brother.

11047.label: 1 Chronicles 25:1
11047.text: Further, David and the chiefs of the service groups separated for the service some of the sons of Aʹsaph, Heʹman and Je·duʹthun the ones prophesying with the harps, with the stringed instruments and with the cymbals. And from their number the official men for their service came to be.

11048.label: 1 Chronicles 25:2
11048.text: Of the sons of Aʹsaph, Zacʹcur and Joseph and Neth·a·niʹah and Ash·a·reʹlah, the sons of Aʹsaph under the control of Aʹsaph the one prophesying under the control of the king.

11049.label: 1 Chronicles 25:3
11049.text: Of Je·duʹthun: the sons of Je·duʹthun, Ged·a·liʹah and Zeʹri and Je·shaʹiah, [and Shimʹe·i,] Hash·a·biʹah and Mat·ti·thiʹah, six, under the control of their father Je·duʹthun, who was prophesying with the harp for thanking and praising Jehovah.

11050.label: 1 Chronicles 25:4
11050.text: Of Heʹman: the sons of Heʹman, Buk·kiʹah, Mat·ta·niʹah, Uzʹzi·el, Shebʹu·el and Jerʹi·moth, Han·a·niʹah, Ha·naʹni, E·liʹa·thah, Gid·dalʹti and Ro·mamʹti-eʹzer, Josh·be·kashʹah, Mal·loʹthi, Hoʹthir, Ma·haʹzi·oth.

11051.label: 1 Chronicles 25:5
11051.text: All these were sons of Heʹman, a visionary of the king in the things of the [true] God to raise up his horn; thus the [true] God proceeded to give Heʹman fourteen sons and three daughters.

11052.label: 1 Chronicles 25:6
11052.text: All these were under the control of their father in song at the house of Jehovah, with cymbals, stringed instruments and harps for the service of the house of the [true] God. Under the control of the king were Aʹsaph and Je·duʹthun and Heʹman.

11053.label: 1 Chronicles 25:7
11053.text: And the number of them together with their brothers trained in song to Jehovah, all experts, came to be two hundred and eighty-eight.

11054.label: 1 Chronicles 25:8
11054.text: So they cast lots as to the things to be taken care of, the little being just the same as the great, the expert along with the learner.

11055.label: 1 Chronicles 25:9
11055.text: And the lot proceeded to come out: the first belonging to Aʹsaph for Joseph, for Ged·a·liʹah the second (he and his brothers and his sons were twelve);

11056.label: 1 Chronicles 25:10
11056.text: the third for Zacʹcur, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

11057.label: 1 Chronicles 25:11
11057.text: the fourth for Izʹri, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

11058.label: 1 Chronicles 25:12
11058.text: the fifth for Neth·a·niʹah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

11059.label: 1 Chronicles 25:13
11059.text: the sixth for Buk·kiʹah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

11060.label: 1 Chronicles 25:14
11060.text: the seventh for Jesh·a·reʹlah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

11061.label: 1 Chronicles 25:15
11061.text: the eighth for Je·shaʹiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

11062.label: 1 Chronicles 25:16
11062.text: the ninth for Mat·ta·niʹah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

11063.label: 1 Chronicles 25:17
11063.text: the tenth for Shimʹe·i, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

11064.label: 1 Chronicles 25:18
11064.text: the eleventh for Azʹar·el, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

11065.label: 1 Chronicles 25:19
11065.text: the twelfth for Hash·a·biʹah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

11066.label: 1 Chronicles 25:20
11066.text: for the thirteenth, Shuʹba·el, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

11067.label: 1 Chronicles 25:21
11067.text: for the fourteenth, Mat·ti·thiʹah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

11068.label: 1 Chronicles 25:22
11068.text: for the fifteenth, for Jerʹe·moth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

11069.label: 1 Chronicles 25:23
11069.text: for the sixteenth, for Han·a·niʹah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

11070.label: 1 Chronicles 25:24
11070.text: for the seventeenth, for Josh·be·kashʹah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

11071.label: 1 Chronicles 25:25
11071.text: for the eighteenth, for Ha·naʹni, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

11072.label: 1 Chronicles 25:26
11072.text: for the nineteenth, for Mal·loʹthi, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

11073.label: 1 Chronicles 25:27
11073.text: for the twentieth, for E·liʹa·thah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

11074.label: 1 Chronicles 25:28
11074.text: for the twenty-first, for Hoʹthir, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

11075.label: 1 Chronicles 25:29
11075.text: for the twenty-second, for Gid·dalʹti, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

11076.label: 1 Chronicles 25:30
11076.text: for the twenty-third, for Ma·haʹzi·oth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

11077.label: 1 Chronicles 25:31
11077.text: for the twenty-fourth, for Ro·mamʹti-eʹzer, his sons and his brothers, twelve.

11078.label: 1 Chronicles 26:1
11078.text: For the divisions of gatekeepers: Of the Koʹrah·ites, Me·shel·e·miʹah the son of Koʹre of the sons of Aʹsaph.

11079.label: 1 Chronicles 26:2
11079.text: And Me·shel·e·miʹah had sons: Zech·a·riʹah the firstborn, Je·diʹa·el the second, Zeb·a·diʹah the third, Jathʹni·el the fourth,

11080.label: 1 Chronicles 26:3
11080.text: Eʹlam the fifth, Je·ho·haʹnan the sixth, Elʹie·ho-eʹnai the seventh.

11081.label: 1 Chronicles 26:4
11081.text: And Oʹbed-eʹdom had sons: She·maiʹah the firstborn, Je·hozʹa·bad the second, Joʹah the third and Saʹcar the fourth and Ne·thanʹel the fifth,

11082.label: 1 Chronicles 26:5
11082.text: Amʹmi·el the sixth, Isʹsa·char the seventh, Pe·ulʹle·thai the eighth; for God had blessed him.

11083.label: 1 Chronicles 26:6
11083.text: And to She·maiʹah his son there were sons born that were rulers of the house of their father, for they were capable, mighty men.

11084.label: 1 Chronicles 26:7
11084.text: The sons of She·maiʹah, Othʹni and Rephʹa·el and Oʹbed, El·zaʹbad, whose brothers were capable men, E·liʹhu and Sem·a·chiʹah.

11085.label: 1 Chronicles 26:8
11085.text: All these were of the sons of Oʹbed-eʹdom, they and their sons and their brothers, capable men with the power for the service, sixty-two belonging to Oʹbed-eʹdom.

11086.label: 1 Chronicles 26:9
11086.text: And Me·shel·e·miʹah had sons and brothers, capable men, eighteen.

11087.label: 1 Chronicles 26:10
11087.text: And Hoʹsah of the sons of Me·rarʹi had sons. Shimʹri was the head, for he did not happen to be the firstborn but his father appointed him as head;

11088.label: 1 Chronicles 26:11
11088.text: Hil·kiʹah the second, Teb·a·liʹah the third, Zech·a·riʹah the fourth. All the sons and brothers of Hoʹsah were thirteen.

11089.label: 1 Chronicles 26:12
11089.text: Of these divisions of the gatekeepers, the headmen had duties exactly as their brothers did, to minister at the house of Jehovah.

11090.label: 1 Chronicles 26:13
11090.text: So they cast lots for the small the same as for the great by their paternal houses, for the different gates.

11091.label: 1 Chronicles 26:14
11091.text: Then the lot to the east fell to Shel·e·miʹah. For Zech·a·riʹah his son, a counselor with discretion, they cast the lots, and his lot got to come out to the north.

11092.label: 1 Chronicles 26:15
11092.text: Oʹbed-eʹdom had his to the south, and his sons had the storehouses.

11093.label: 1 Chronicles 26:16
11093.text: Shupʹpim and Hoʹsah had theirs to the west close by the Gate Shalʹlech·eth by the highway that goes up, guard group corresponding with guard group;

11094.label: 1 Chronicles 26:17
11094.text: to the east there were six Levites; to the north for a day, four; to the south for a day, four; and for the stores, two by two;

11095.label: 1 Chronicles 26:18
11095.text: for the portico to the west, four at the highway, two at the portico.

11096.label: 1 Chronicles 26:19
11096.text: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers of the sons of the Koʹrah·ites and of the sons of Me·rarʹi.

11097.label: 1 Chronicles 26:20
11097.text: As regards the Levites, A·hiʹjah was over the treasures of the house of the [true] God and over the treasures of the things made holy.

11098.label: 1 Chronicles 26:21
11098.text: The sons of Laʹdan, the sons of the Gerʹshon·ite belonging to Laʹdan; the heads of the paternal houses belonging to Laʹdan the Gerʹshon·ite, Je·hiʹe·li.

11099.label: 1 Chronicles 26:22
11099.text: The sons of Je·hiʹe·li, Zeʹtham and Joel his brother, were over the treasures of the house of Jehovah.

11100.label: 1 Chronicles 26:23
11100.text: For the Amʹram·ites, for the Izʹhar·ites, for the Heʹbron·ites, for the Uz·ziʹel·ites,

11101.label: 1 Chronicles 26:24
11101.text: even Shebʹu·el the son of Gerʹshom the son of Moses was a leader over the stores.

11102.label: 1 Chronicles 26:25
11102.text: As regards his brothers, of E·li·eʹzer there was Re·ha·biʹah his son and Je·shaʹiah his son and Joʹram his son and Zichʹri his son and She·loʹmoth his son.

11103.label: 1 Chronicles 26:26
11103.text: This She·loʹmoth and his brothers were over all the treasures of the things made holy, that David the king and the heads of the paternal houses, and the chiefs of the thousands and of the hundreds, and the chiefs of the army had made holy.

11104.label: 1 Chronicles 26:27
11104.text: From the wars and from the spoil they had made [things] holy to maintain the house of Jehovah.

11105.label: 1 Chronicles 26:28
11105.text: And also all that Samuel the seer and Saul the son of Kish and Abʹner the son of Ner and Joʹab the son of Ze·ruʹiah had made holy. What anyone made holy was under the control of She·loʹmith and his brothers.

11106.label: 1 Chronicles 26:29
11106.text: Of the Izʹhar·ites, Chen·a·niʹah and his sons were for the outside business as officers and as judges over Israel.

11107.label: 1 Chronicles 26:30
11107.text: Of the Heʹbron·ites, Hash·a·biʹah and his brothers, capable men, a thousand seven hundred, were over the administration of Israel in the region of the Jordan to the west for all the work of Jehovah and for the king’s service.

11108.label: 1 Chronicles 26:31
11108.text: Of the Heʹbron·ites, Je·riʹjah was the head of the Heʹbron·ites by its generations by forefathers. In the fortieth year of David’s kingship they were sought out, and valiant, mighty men came to be found among them in Jaʹzer in Gilʹe·ad.

11109.label: 1 Chronicles 26:32
11109.text: And his brothers, capable men, were two thousand seven hundred, heads of the paternal houses. So David the king assigned them over the Reuʹben·ites and the Gadʹites and the half tribe of the Ma·nasʹsites, for every matter of the [true] God and matter of the king.

11110.label: 1 Chronicles 27:1
11110.text: As for the sons of Israel by their number, the heads of the paternal houses and the chiefs of the thousands and of the hundreds and their officers that were ministering to the king in every matter of the divisions of those that came in and that went out month by month for all the months of the year, each division was twenty-four thousand.

11111.label: 1 Chronicles 27:2
11111.text: Over the first division of the first month there was Ja·shoʹbe·am the son of Zabʹdi·el, and in his division there were twenty-four thousand.

11112.label: 1 Chronicles 27:3
11112.text: Some of the sons of Peʹrez the head of all the chiefs of the service groups were for the first month.

11113.label: 1 Chronicles 27:4
11113.text: And over the division of the second month there was Doʹdai the A·hoʹhite with his division, and Mikʹloth was the leader, and in his division there were twenty-four thousand.

11114.label: 1 Chronicles 27:5
11114.text: The chief of the third service group for the third month was Be·naiʹah the son of Je·hoiʹa·da the chief priest, and in his division there were twenty-four thousand.

11115.label: 1 Chronicles 27:6
11115.text: This Be·naiʹah was a mighty man of the thirty and over the thirty; and [over] his division there was Am·mizʹa·bad his son.

11116.label: 1 Chronicles 27:7
11116.text: The fourth for the fourth month was Asʹa·hel, Joʹab’s brother, and Zeb·a·diʹah his son after him, and in his division there were twenty-four thousand.

11117.label: 1 Chronicles 27:8
11117.text: The fifth chief for the fifth month was Shamʹhuth the Izʹrah·ite, and in his division there were twenty-four thousand.

11118.label: 1 Chronicles 27:9
11118.text: The sixth for the sixth month was Iʹra the son of Ikʹkesh the Te·koʹite, and in his division there were twenty-four thousand.

11119.label: 1 Chronicles 27:10
11119.text: The seventh for the seventh month was Heʹlez the Pelʹo·nite of the sons of Eʹphra·im, and in his division there were twenty-four thousand.

11120.label: 1 Chronicles 27:11
11120.text: The eighth for the eighth month was Sibʹbe·cai the Huʹshath·ite of the Zeʹrah·ites, and in his division there were twenty-four thousand.

11121.label: 1 Chronicles 27:12
11121.text: The ninth for the ninth month was Abi-eʹzer the Anʹa·thoth·ite of the Benʹja·min·ites, and in his division there were twenty-four thousand.

11122.label: 1 Chronicles 27:13
11122.text: The tenth for the tenth month was Maʹha·rai the Ne·tophʹa·thite of the Zeʹrah·ites, and in his division there were twenty-four thousand.

11123.label: 1 Chronicles 27:14
11123.text: The eleventh for the eleventh month was Be·naiʹah the Pirʹa·thon·ite of the sons of Eʹphra·im, and in his division there were twenty-four thousand.

11124.label: 1 Chronicles 27:15
11124.text: The twelfth for the twelfth month was Helʹdai the Ne·tophʹa·thite, of Othʹni·el, and in his division there were twenty-four thousand.

11125.label: 1 Chronicles 27:16
11125.text: And over the tribes of Israel, of the Reuʹben·ites, E·li·eʹzer the son of Zichʹri was leader; of the Simʹe·on·ites, Sheph·a·tiʹah the son of Maʹa·cah;

11126.label: 1 Chronicles 27:17
11126.text: of Leʹvi, Hash·a·biʹah the son of Kem·uʹel; of Aaron, Zaʹdok;

11127.label: 1 Chronicles 27:18
11127.text: of Judah, E·liʹhu, one of David’s brothers; of Isʹsa·char, Omʹri the son of Miʹcha·el;

11128.label: 1 Chronicles 27:19
11128.text: of Zebʹu·lun, Ish·maʹiah the son of O·ba·diʹah; of Naphʹta·li, Jerʹi·moth the son of Azʹri·el;

11129.label: 1 Chronicles 27:20
11129.text: of the sons of Eʹphra·im, Ho·sheʹa the son of Az·a·ziʹah; of the half tribe of Ma·nasʹseh, Joel the son of Pe·daiʹah;

11130.label: 1 Chronicles 27:21
11130.text: of the half tribe of Ma·nasʹseh in Gilʹe·ad, Idʹdo the son of Zech·a·riʹah; of Benjamin, Ja·a·siʹel the son of Abʹner;

11131.label: 1 Chronicles 27:22
11131.text: of Dan, Azʹar·el the son of Je·roʹham. These were the princes of the tribes of Israel.

11132.label: 1 Chronicles 27:23
11132.text: And David did not take the number of those from twenty years of age and under, because Jehovah had promised to make Israel as many as the stars of the heavens.

11133.label: 1 Chronicles 27:24
11133.text: Joʹab the son of Ze·ruʹiah had himself started to take the count, but he did not finish; and for this there came to be indignation against Israel, and the number did not come up into the account of the affairs of the days of King David.

11134.label: 1 Chronicles 27:25
11134.text: And over the treasures of the king there was Azʹma·veth the son of Adʹi·el. And over the treasures in the field, in the cities and in the villages and in the towers there was Jonʹa·than the son of Uz·ziʹah.

11135.label: 1 Chronicles 27:26
11135.text: And over the doers of work in the field, for the cultivation of the soil, there was Ezʹri the son of Cheʹlub.

11136.label: 1 Chronicles 27:27
11136.text: And over the vineyards there was Shimʹe·i the Raʹmath·ite; and over that which was in the vineyards for the wine supplies there was Zabʹdi the Shiphʹmite.

11137.label: 1 Chronicles 27:28
11137.text: And over the olive groves and the sycamore trees that were in the She·pheʹlah there was Baʹal-haʹnan the Ge·deʹrite; and over the oil supplies there was Joʹash.

11138.label: 1 Chronicles 27:29
11138.text: And over the herds that were grazing in Sharʹon there was Shitʹrai the Sharʹon·ite; and over the herds in the low plains there was Shaʹphat the son of Adʹlai.

11139.label: 1 Chronicles 27:30
11139.text: And over the camels there was Oʹbil the Ishʹma·el·ite; and over the she-asses there was Jeh·deʹiah the Me·ronʹo·thite.

11140.label: 1 Chronicles 27:31
11140.text: And over the flocks there was Jaʹziz the Hagʹrite. All these were the chiefs of the goods that belonged to King David.

11141.label: 1 Chronicles 27:32
11141.text: And Jonʹa·than, David’s nephew, was a counselor, a man of understanding, he being also a secretary; and Je·hiʹel the son of Hachʹmo·ni was with the king’s sons.

11142.label: 1 Chronicles 27:33
11142.text: And A·hithʹo·phel was a counselor of the king; and Huʹshai the Arʹchite was the king’s companion.

11143.label: 1 Chronicles 27:34
11143.text: And after A·hithʹo·phel there were Je·hoiʹa·da the son of Be·naiʹah and A·biʹa·thar; and Joʹab was chief of the army of the king.

11144.label: 1 Chronicles 28:1
11144.text: And David proceeded to congregate all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes and the princes of the divisions of those ministering to the king and the chiefs of thousands and the chiefs of hundreds and the chiefs of all the goods and livestock of the king and of his sons, together with the court officials and the mighty men, even every valiant, mighty man, to Jerusalem.

11145.label: 1 Chronicles 28:2
11145.text: Then David the king rose to his feet and said: “Hear me, my brothers and my people. As for me, it was close to my heart to build a resting house for the ark of the covenant of Jehovah and as the footstool of our God, and I had made preparation to build.

11146.label: 1 Chronicles 28:3
11146.text: And the [true] God himself said to me, ‘You will not build a house to my name; for a man of wars you are, and blood you have spilled.’

11147.label: 1 Chronicles 28:4
11147.text: Accordingly Jehovah the God of Israel chose me out of all the house of my father to become king over Israel to time indefinite; for it was Judah that he chose as leader, and in the house of Judah my father’s house, and among my father’s sons, I was the one whom he approved, to make me king over all Israel;

11148.label: 1 Chronicles 28:5
11148.text: and out of all my sons (for many are the sons whom Jehovah has given me) he then chose Solʹo·mon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingship of Jehovah over Israel.

11149.label: 1 Chronicles 28:6
11149.text: “Further, he said to me, ‘Solʹo·mon your son is the one that will build my house and my courtyards; for I have chosen him as my son, and I myself shall become his father.

11150.label: 1 Chronicles 28:7
11150.text: And I shall certainly establish his kingship firmly to time indefinite if he will be strongly resolved to do my commandments and my judicial decisions, as at this day.’

11151.label: 1 Chronicles 28:8
11151.text: And now, before the eyes of all Israel, Jehovah’s congregation, and in the ears of our God, take care and search for all the commandments of Jehovah YOUR God, in order that YOU may possess the good land and may certainly pass it on as an inheritance to YOUR sons after YOU to time indefinite.

11152.label: 1 Chronicles 28:9
11152.text: “And you, Solʹo·mon my son, know the God of your father and serve him with a complete heart and with a delightful soul; for all hearts Jehovah is searching, and every inclination of the thoughts he is discerning. If you search for him, he will let himself be found by you; but if you leave him, he will cast you off forever.

11153.label: 1 Chronicles 28:10
11153.text: See, now, for Jehovah himself has chosen you to build a house as a sanctuary. Be courageous and act.”

11154.label: 1 Chronicles 28:11
11154.text: And David proceeded to give Solʹo·mon his son the architectural plan of the porch and of its houses and its storerooms and its roof chambers and its dark inner rooms and the house of the propitiatory cover;

11155.label: 1 Chronicles 28:12
11155.text: even the architectural plan of everything that had come to be with him by inspiration for the courtyards of Jehovah’s house and for all the dining rooms all around, for the treasures of the house of the [true] God and for the treasures of the things made holy;

11156.label: 1 Chronicles 28:13
11156.text: and for the divisions of the priests and of the Levites and for all the work of the service of Jehovah’s house and for all the utensils of the service of Jehovah’s house;

11157.label: 1 Chronicles 28:14
11157.text: for the gold by weight, the gold for all the utensils for the different services, for all the utensils of silver by weight, for all the utensils for the different services;

11158.label: 1 Chronicles 28:15
11158.text: and the weight for the lampstands of gold and their lamps of gold, by weight of the different lampstands and their lamps, and for the lampstands of silver by weight for the lampstand and its lamps according to the service of the different lampstands;

11159.label: 1 Chronicles 28:16
11159.text: and the gold by weight for the tables of the layer bread, for the different tables, and silver for the tables of silver;

11160.label: 1 Chronicles 28:17
11160.text: and the forks and the bowls and the pitchers of pure gold, and for the small gold bowls by weight for the different small bowls, and for the small silver bowls by weight for the different small bowls;

11161.label: 1 Chronicles 28:18
11161.text: and for the incense altar refined gold by weight and for the representation of the chariot, namely, the cherubs of gold for spreading [their wings] out and screening over the ark of the covenant of Jehovah.

11162.label: 1 Chronicles 28:19
11162.text: “He gave insight for the entire thing in writing from the hand of Jehovah upon me, even for all the works of the architectural plan.”

11163.label: 1 Chronicles 28:20
11163.text: And David went on to say to Solʹo·mon his son: “Be courageous and strong and act. Do not be afraid nor be terrified, for Jehovah God, my God, is with you. He will not desert you or leave you until all the work of the service of Jehovah’s house is finished.

11164.label: 1 Chronicles 28:21
11164.text: And here are the divisions of the priests and of the Levites for all the service of the house of the [true] God; and with you in all the work there is every willing one with skill for all the service, and also the princes and all the people, for all your words.”

11165.label: 1 Chronicles 29:1
11165.text: David the king now said to all the congregation: “Solʹo·mon my son, the one [whom] God has chosen, is young and delicate, but the work is great; for the castle is not for man, but for Jehovah God.

11166.label: 1 Chronicles 29:2
11166.text: And according to all my power I have prepared for the house of my God the gold for the goldwork, and the silver for the silverwork, and the copper for the copperwork, the iron for the ironwork, and the timbers for the timberwork; onyx stones, and stones to be set with hard mortar, and mosaic pebbles, and every precious stone, and alabaster stones in great quantity.

11167.label: 1 Chronicles 29:3
11167.text: And since I am taking pleasure in the house of my God, there is yet a special property of mine, gold and silver; I do give it to the house of my God over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house:

11168.label: 1 Chronicles 29:4
11168.text: three thousand talents of gold of the gold of Oʹphir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, for coating the walls of the houses;

11169.label: 1 Chronicles 29:5
